raw.excerpt: Senior Product ManagerAcuityMD is a software and data platform that accelerates access to medical technologies.
raw.description:
Senior Product Manager

AcuityMD is a software and data platform that accelerates access to medical technologies. We help MedTech companies understand how their products are used, why customers vary, and identify opportunities for physicians to better serve their patients. Each year, the FDA approves ~6,000 new medical devices. Our solution helps MedTech companies get these products to physicians more effectively so they can improve patient care with the latest technology. We're backed by Benchmark, Redpoint, ICONIQ Growth, and Ajax Health. We're a high-growth AI and Data company scaling rapidly.

We’re hiring a Senior Product Manager to take ownership of a major product area. You’ll work across engineering, design, go-to-market, and customers to solve high-impact problems, build scalable software, and deliver tangible business value.

You’ll thrive here if you’re (1) a high-agency generalist with a strong product management foundation - skilled at cutting through ambiguity, shipping great products, and working in fast-moving, collaborative environments - and (2) AI literate. We value both deep PM craft (e.g., understanding user needs, making smart tradeoffs, and driving outcomes) AND some comfort with getting uncomfortable using the latest AI tools (e.g., prototyping and diving into the code base with the latest models).

This is an opportunity to join a high-growth company during a critical scaling phase. You’ll be optimizing mature products and shaping what comes next.

Team Mission

We are building a world-class product team to build software features as meticulously crafted and data driven as the highly specialized MedTech products that save lives each day. Our team is the critical link between what our engineers build and what our customers need. We are looking for product leaders to develop deep empathy for our users, apply data to prioritize user needs, and bring new features to life by aligning and coordinating across technical and customer-facing teams.

Responsibilities

  • Own a product area end-to-end: from discovery and roadmap to execution, launch, and iteration.
  • Understand our users deeply—their workflows, pain points, goals, and contexts.
  • Collaborate tightly with Engineering and UX to craft intuitive, performant, and impactful product experiences.
  • Prioritize ruthlessly, balancing long-term vision with immediate value delivery.
  • Communicate clearly across audiences—technical and non-technical, internal and external.
  • Work with AI tools in your day-to-day and contribute to the design of AI-native features that enhance user workflows and drive differentiation.
  • Measure impact: define, track, and improve product and business KPIs.
  • Raise the bar: uphold strong standards for quality, curiosity, and integrity in how we build.

Your Profile

  • 5+ years of product management experience, ideally in B2B SaaS.
  • Track record of shipping high-quality software that solves real user problems.
  • Strong product fundamentals: discovery, roadmap planning, prioritization, spec writing, stakeholder alignment, and post-launch iteration.
  • Demonstrated ability to thrive in ambiguity and make sound decisions under constraints.
  • Clear, concise communicator—both written and verbal. You write to think and drive alignment.
  • Comfortable using AI tools to accelerate your work. Experience building AI-powered features is a plus, not a requirement.
  • Curious, thoughtful, and motivated by making things better—for users, for teammates, and for the company.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience working on vertical SaaS, workflow automation, or data-rich tools.
  • Prior product management experience in a scaling startup environment.
  • Familiarity with LLMs, data-powered product features, or complex user roles/personas.
  • Ability to prototype in tools like Figma, Make, or other low-code platforms.
  • Demonstrated mentorship or product leadership experience.

AcuityMD is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, market data and may vary from the range provided. Base salary range: $175,000-$215,000

You must have an eligible work permit in the USA to be considered for this position

We Offer:

  • Ground floor opportunity: Join a high-growth startup, backed by world-class investors across Enterprise SaaS and Medical Devices (Benchmark, Redpoint Ventures, and Ajax Health).
  • Learning Budget: Reimbursements for relevant learning and up-skilling opportunities.
  • Remote work: AcuityMD is committed to supporting full-remote flexibility for employees in the US. We provide a work-from-home stipend for all employees.
  • Flexible PTO: Generous time off and flexible hours give you the freedom to do your best work.
  • Paid Health, Dental, and Vision Plans: We offer 100% paid health, dental, and vision plans for all employees and 75% paid for our employees' dependents.
  • Home Office Stipend: $1,000 to invest in remote office equipment and WiFi reimbursement.
  • Optional Team Retreats: We meet in-person multiple times per year for co-working and social gatherings.
  • Parental Leave: 8-16 weeks of fully-paid, flexible parental leave.

Who We Are:

The Company: We are builders, who are inspired by our mission to expand patient access to cutting-edge medical technologies. We value working collaboratively to solve hard problems for our customers with simple, innovative solutions. We push ourselves to learn with empathy. We foster an active culture of mentorship and inclusion, and we welcome new team members that share our values.

We're backed by Benchmark, Redpoint Ventures, Ajax Health, ICONIQ Growth and several other leading software and medical device investors. Since Acuity launched in 2020, we've brought on customers ranging from publicly traded Fortune 500 companies to innovative growth-stage companies and regional medical device distributors.

The Product: AcuityMD uses data and software to help teams collaborate around the complex relationships they have with the users of medical technologies: doctors. Our platform empowers medical technology companies to see how their products are used, understand why outcomes vary, and identify opportunities where physicians or sites of care can better serve their patients.

How We Work:

AcuityMD is a remote-first company. We believe the best talent isn't confined to one zip code, so our team works from wherever they do their best work, across the U.S.

We also believe some of our best work happens face-to-face. Critical projects move faster, our products get better, and our community gets stronger when we're in the same room, so we bring the team together throughout the year for company-wide and team on-sites built around that work.

In practice: expect 4-5 in-person opportunities a year through company/team on-sites and in-person collaboration for critical projects. If you're based near our Boston hub, there's no set requirement for how often you come into the office, that's your call, based on what works best for you and your team.

AcuityMD is an Equal Opportunity Employer

AcuityMD is seeking to create a diverse work environment because all teams are stronger with different perspectives and life experiences. We strongly encourage people of all backgrounds to apply. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, gender, religion, color, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. All employees and contractors of AcuityMD are responsible for maintaining a work culture free from discrimination and harassment by treating others with kindness and respect.

raw.description:
At Hyatt, we believe in the power of belonging- of making people feel at home no matter where they are in the world. We turn trips into journeys, encounters into experiences, and jobs into careers. Join a team that is making travel more human. Connected. Sustainable. Here, everyone's role matters. Opportunities are yours to shape. Your individuality is celebrated. At the heart of Hyatt is our shared belief that hospitality is more than just a job - it's a career for people who care.

Alila Ventana Big Sur is where sky, sea, mountains, and redwoods converge to create a setting of unmatched beauty and tranquility. A luxury resort deeply rooted in authenticity and connection, we offer personalized, intuitive service that transforms every guest experience.

As the Cluster Director of Business Development for Alila Ventana Big Sur and Alila Napa Valley, you will lead a leisure sales team and drive commercial success across a cluster of luxury resorts through strategic leadership, tailored sales planning, and deep engagement with high-level internal and external stakeholders. You’ll partner closely with on-property Directors of Sales and Marketing and collaborate with regional commercial team, the Hyatt Sales Force, and key luxury travel influencers in all transient market segments to deliver measurable growth in revenue.

This is a dynamic opportunity to blend creative sales solutions with operational excellence, financial discipline and strategic planning. Helping shape the future of the Alila.

What You’ll Do

  • Provide unified but customized sales leadership for your assignment markets and hotels
  • Guide the resorts through cohesive transient business development strategy
  • Actively contribute to the creation of data-informed strategic revenue plans in partnership with DOSMs
  • Activate and Maintain senior-level relationships with agency owner/managers, luxury consortia networks, card programs and other sources of transient leisure business
  • Monitor evolving market demand, evaluate competitor activity, conduct targeted prospecting, and open new channels of revenue through sales partnerships.
  • Champion the Alila brand within luxury travel, representing the North America portfolio at industry trade shows, client events, and through high-touch programming.
  • Serve as a critical connector between on-property sales teams, the Hyatt Sales Force, and corporate stakeholders to ensure alignment and delivery against regional objectives.

Who You Are

  • A connector, strategist, and storyteller who can drive commercial results through influence as much as through action.
  • Comfortable leading with data, and using metrics to fine-tune your approach.
  • Passionate about luxury travel, and fluent in the language of buyers and hospitality trendsetters.
  • An agile team player who thrives in fast-paced environments and isn’t afraid to challenge legacy thinking with thoughtful innovation.

Hyatt is proud to offer exceptional benefits, which include

  • Annual allotment of free and discounted hotel stays at Hyatt hotels globally
  • Work-life benefits including well-being initiatives such as a complimentary Headspace subscription, and tuition reimbursement.
  • A global family assistance policy with paid time off following the birth or adoption of a child as well as financial assistance for adoption
  • Paid Time Off
  • Medical, Dental, Vision after 30 days of employment
  • 401K with company match after 1 year of employment

The salary range for this opportunity is $115,000 – $140,000 annually. Decisions regarding individual salaries will be based on a number of factors including experience and training levels.

This position is remote with travel to the resorts required as needed with a minimum travel expectation of 25%. Ideally the candidate is located in California. Relocation assistance can be provided.

·5+ years of sales or business development experience in the transient/leisure luxury hospitality space

·Prior success working with or within high-end travel agency networks (Virtuoso, FHR, Signature, etc.)

·Experience in a regional, multi-property, or hybrid sales leadership role

·Strong understanding of both group and leisure market dynamics

·Proficient in leveraging sales and analytics tools (Amadeus, STR, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Ideas, Thoughtspot)

·Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills

·Willingness to travel as needed

All qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.

raw.description:
The Partner Development Manager is responsible for developing and scaling i2's North American partner ecosystem to accelerate market reach, expand delivery capacity, increase customer value, and drive revenue growth.

This is a remote position - United States and Canada

This is a strategic business development role focuses on recruiting, onboarding, enabling, and growing high-value partners across the United States and Canada. The successful candidate will build a repeatable partner program that creates organizational leverage and enables the business to scale without proportional increases in internal headcount.

Working closely with Sales, Marketing, Product Management, Professional Services, Customer Success, and Executive Leadership, the role will establish the framework, relationships, and operating model required to maximize partner-generated business impact. This aligns directly with North America's ecosystem-led growth strategy.

Key Responsibilities

Partner Recruitment & Ecosystem Expansion (25%)

Develop and expand a strategic partner ecosystem across North America.

Responsibilities:

  • Identify, recruit, and activate new strategic partners

  • Build relationships with system integrators, consulting firms, VARs, technology alliances, and referral partners

  • Create and maintain a partner recruitment pipeline

  • Evaluate geographic, industry, and capability coverage gaps

  • Execute partner recruitment plans aligned with corporate growth objectives

Success Measures:

  • New partners recruited

  • Strategic partner agreements executed

  • Ecosystem coverage expansion

  • Active partner growth

Partner Onboarding & Enablement (25%)

Accelerate partner readiness and productivity through structured onboarding and enablement.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute partner onboarding programs

  • Coordinate training and certification initiatives

  • Create partner enablement content and resources

  • Ensure partner understanding of i2 solutions, value propositions, and target markets

  • Establish partner success milestones

Success Measures:

  • Partner activation rates

  • Certifications achieved

  • Time-to-productivity

  • Partner readiness metrics

Partner-Sourced Pipeline Development (25%)

Generate qualified sales opportunities through joint go-to-market activities.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop joint business plans with strategic partners

  • Execute co-sell initiatives with sales teams

  • Drive partner-led demand generation activities

  • Support account planning and deal registration programs

  • Assist partners in identifying and qualifying opportunities

Success Measures:

  • Partner-sourced pipeline

  • Qualified opportunities created

  • Joint account plans executed

  • Opportunity progression rates

Partner-Influenced Revenue & Engagement (25%)

Increase partner participation throughout the customer lifecycle.

Responsibilities:

  • Conduct regular Partner Business Reviews

  • Build partner growth plans

  • Increase partner involvement in customer success initiatives

  • Support retention and expansion strategies

  • Monitor partner performance and optimize engagement

Success Measures:

  • Partner-influenced revenue

  • Partner-assisted renewals

  • Expansion opportunities generated

  • Partner engagement and health scores

Qualifications

Required

  • 5+ years of experience in Partner Development, Channel Sales, Alliances, Business Development, or Ecosystem Growth

  • Proven success recruiting and developing strategic partners

  • Experience building partner programs, onboarding frameworks, or enablement initiatives

  • Demonstrated ability to influence executive-level stakeholders

  • Strong relationship-building, presentation, and communication skills

  • Ability to work cross-functionally across Sales, Marketing, Product, Professional Services, and Customer Success

Preferred

  • Enterprise software or SaaS experience

  • Public safety, intelligence, investigative analytics, cybersecurity, or government technology experience

  • Experience working with system integrators, consulting firms, and strategic alliances

  • Experience building partner programs from the ground up

Travel

  • Approximately 25%-40% travel throughout the United States and Canada

  • Attendance at partner meetings, industry conferences, customer engagements, and internal planning sessions

Compensation

Base Salary Range: $125,000 - $135,000

Target OTE: $175,000 - $200,000+

Por isso, aqui temos espaço para todas as pessoas, independente de raça, gênero, idade, orientação sexual, crença religiosa ou deficiência. 🏳️‍🌈👩🏾‍🦽

O que buscamos?

  • Experiência sólida em Backend com e TypeScript, arquitetura de APIs REST e integração complexa entre Sistemas Enterprise;
  • Experiência em arquitetura dos ambientes (manter fluxos de trabalho resilientes, implementar gatilhos, regras de negócio, tratamento robusto de exceções, políticas de nova tentativa (retry/fallback) e automação de ITSM para abertura ou encaminhamento de chamados);
  • Domínio em atendimento automatizado e IA aplicada (compreensão do pedido do usuário (NLU), busca semântica em base de conhecimento com RAG, engenharia e orquestração de instruções para LLMs e disparo de ações e agentes resolvedores);
  • Capacidade comprovada de implantar aplicações em produção, monitorar a saúde do sistema, realizar análise profunda de logs, mitigar erros diretamente na causa raiz e operar com fluidez em ambiente Linux;
  • Experiência com testes automatizados (validação em cenários reais), versionamento com Git, documentação técnica estruturada e práticas rigorosas de código limpo (Clean Code);
  • Visão macro e facilidade para entender o processo de ponta a ponta, traduzindo o alinhamento inicial no Microsoft Teams até as regras estruturadas no sistema de chamados, com facilidade para organizar as demandas e distribuir as tarefas do time no dia a dia.

Como será o seu dia a dia:

  • Construção das SDKs sobre vertentes dos clientes,otimização dos fluxos de trabalho eorquestração divergentes;
  • Desenvolvimento: escrever, evoluir e arquitetar o código em e TypeScript durante a construção das vertentes de AI Assist, incluindo autoatendimento no Microsoft Teams, apoio à resolução de chamados, inteligência operacional (AIOps) e automação de ponta a ponta entre sistemas;
  • Integração: Conectar de forma segura o canal de atendimento, a base de conhecimento estruturada, os sistemas de chamados (ITSM) e as APIs de clientes, garantindo tratamento de erro críticos e observabilidade completa via logs;
  • Qualidade e segurança: desenvolver testes automatizados, realizar code review, identificar vulnerabilidades ou falhas de segurança durante o ciclo de desenvolvimento (princípio de menor privilégio) e aplicar correções com o cenário devidamente documentado;
  • Implantação e suporte: acompanhar a entrada crítica de clientes em ambiente de produção (GitOps/CI), investigar incidentes graves através de métricas e depuração de código, ajustando fluxos até neutralizar a causa raiz do problema;
  • Documentação: descrever detalhadamente a arquitetura dos fluxos, contratos de API e decisões técnicas para garantir a sustentação do sistema e facilitar o onboarding de outros profissionais do time.

Conhecimentos e diferenciais em:

  • Python: Domínio na linguagem para a criação de scripts de automação, pipelines de dados (arquitetura Medallion/BigQuery) ou serviços auxiliares de infraestrutura;
  • Containers & Infra: sólido conhecimento em Docker, Kubernetes e gerenciamento de infraestrutura como código (IaC) com Terraform em escala global;
  • Persistência e Cache: experiência prática com bancos de dados relacionais (SQL) e implementação do Redis para cache de alta performance e controle de concorrência em produção;
  • Automação Low-Code/No-Code: familiaridade com ecossistemas corporativos de automação, incluindo fluxos, conectores e gatilho no Power Automate Cloud e Copilot Studio;
  • Monitoramento & Observabilidade: ampla experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento de mercado, como Grafana, Datadog, Prometheus e Zabbix, para acompanhamento de métricas operacionais (MTTR, MTBF);
  • Metodologias: atuação integrada com ferramentas como Jira ou Azure DevOps, utilizando frameworks Kanban ou Scrum para a organização do fluxo de entregas;
  • Sistemas em Produção: histórico comprovado de ter projetado e colocado em produção agentes de IA, SDKs próprios e integrações complexas com sistemas de chamados (DeskManager, Cervello, etc.);
  • Arquitetura Limpa: aplicação rigorosa de padrões de projeto (Design Patterns) e boas práticas de código limpo em serviços construídos sobre a stack

Position Summary

The Nautilus Solar Energy Capital Markets Associate will be responsible for executing project financings and strategic analysis to support the development of Nautilus’ expanding solar portfolio. The position requires a detail-oriented individual with a strong financial modeling background. The position [JE1] is a fully remote opportunity with occasional travel.

Responsibilities:

Financial Analysis and Modeling:

  • Build and maintain complex financial models, including project finance models, DCF analysis, and valuation assessments

raw.description:
Position: Research Assistant

Department: Pediatrics Research (CHEER)

Schedule: 40 hours per week, Remote

POSITION SUMMARY:

The Center for Health Equity, Education, and Research (CHEER) at Boston Medical Center is a world-class center for maternal child health advocacy, training and research. Its mission is to bring about health equity by collaborating with community-based partners and providing technical assistance, training, evaluation, and inspiration. CHEER focuses on underserved populations, with a particular emphasis on maternal child health and nutrition.

The Research Assistant will participate in and oversee the administrative aspects of CHEER’s programs/grants and interact with program participants, investigators, students RAs, and other research staff. Duties include: assisting with program recruitment, scheduling meetings, administering questionnaires, creating and filing program documents, entering and updating data, maintaining databases, running reports, and performing other administrative tasks. The RA maintains contact with the participating sites to insure complete and timely data collection, maintains sites’ files, assists with documenting financial and budgetary needs of the grant, and supporting the research team with the preparation of data and other reports.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Responsible for the administrative aspects of CHEER’s programs, including: managing program records and handling communication needs of the program.

  • Provides assistance in the development of reports, presentations, and data analysis.

  • Creates and edits multimedia content, including short video clips, training videos, and other digital resources to support education, outreach, and program communications.

  • Assists in the development, scheduling, and publication of social media content, including managing the organization's social media content calendar, creating graphics and copy, and posting content across platforms

  • Assists in data collection and provides feedback on progress.

  • Schedules meetings with program participants; conducts reminder communications.

  • Reviews the data collection forms for programs; checks work of junior staff performing data entry to ensure timely and accurate entry. Provides technical guidance to junior staff.

  • Conducts literature searches. Assists Investigators with manuscript and presentation preparation and research.

  • Participates in staff meetings/initiatives including appropriate quality improvement and education activities, or if unable to attend non-mandatory activities, accepts responsibility to review meeting minutes and becomes knowledgeable of issues discussed.

  • Performs office-related duties such as answering phones, managing email accounts, picking up and delivering mail, ordering and distributing office supplies, handling faxes, scanning, filing, photocopying, collating materials, maintaining the update of policy manuals, etc.

The above statements in this job description are intended to depict the general nature and level of work assigned to the employee(s) in this job. The above is not intended to represent an exhaustive list of accountable duties and responsibilities required

JOB REQUIREMENTS

EDUCATION:

  • Bachelor’s degree is required by time of hire. Major in a field related to the research highly preferred.

EXPERIENCE:

  • Preferred: Minimum of one to two years of experience in the public health field or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS:

  • Experience with recruiting subjects, with an understanding of the ethical and technical conduct of research.

  • Excellent English communication skills (oral and written).

  • Bilingual or multi-lingual skills in Spanish is preferred.

  • Cultural sensitivity and comfort with a wide range of social, racial and ethnic populations

  • Organizational ability to perform multiple tasks efficiently and to prioritize duties.

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications including Word, Excel, and Access and PowerPoint. Experience with statistical analysis tools a plus. Ability to perform basic data management tasks (coding, data entry, data cleaning, retrieval).

  • Ability to perform basic data analysis and reporting (in words, numbers and graphics).

  • Experience creating and managing social media content, including developing content calendars, writing engaging copy, and publishing content across multiple platforms.

  • Proficiency with graphic design and multimedia tools (e.g., Canva or Adobe Creative Suite) and experience editing short-form videos and creating educational or training videos for digital audiences.

JOB BENEFITS:

  • Competitive pay

  • Tuition reimbursement and tuition remission programs

  • Highly subsidized medical, dental, and vision insurance options

  • Career Advancement/Professional Development: Access a wealth of ongoing training and development opportunities that will not only enhance your skills but also expand your knowledge base especially for individuals pursuing careers in medicine or biomedical research.

  • Pioneering Research: Engage in groundbreaking research projects that are driving the forefront of biomedical science.

ABOUT THE DEPARTMENT:

As the primary teaching hospital for Boston University Chobanian & Avedisian School of Medicine and BU schools of public health and dentistry, intellectual rigor shapes our inquiries. Our research is led by a belief that skin color, zip code, and financial circumstances shouldn’t dictate health.

Boston Medical Center is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer. If you need accommodation for any part of the application process because of a medical condition or disability, please send an e-mail to or call 617-638-8582 to let us know the nature of your request.

Compensation Range:

$16.35- $22.84

This range offers an estimate based on the minimum job qualifications. However, our approach to determining base pay is comprehensive, and a broad range of factors is considered when making an offer. This includes education, experience, skills, and certifications/licensures as they directly relate to position requirements; as well as business/organizational needs, internal equity, and market-competitiveness. In addition, BMCHS offers generous total compensation that includes, but is not limited to, benefits (medical, dental, vision, pharmacy), discretionary annual bonuses and merit increases, Flexible Spending Accounts, 403(b) savings matches, paid time off, career advancement opportunities, and resources to support employee and family well-being.

NOTE: This range is based on Boston-area data, and is subject to modification based on geographic location.

Equal Opportunity Employer/Disabled/Veterans

According to the FTC, there has been a rise in employment offer scams. Our current job openings are listed on our website and applications are received only through our website. We do not ask or require downloads of any applications, or “apps” job offers are not extended over text messages or social media platforms. We do not ask individuals to purchase equipment for or prior to employment.

raw.description:
Who We Are

Join a team that puts its People First! As a member of First American’s family of companies, Data & Analytics is a national provider of property-centric information, analytics, risk management and valuation solutions. First American maintains and curates the industry’s largest property and ownership dataset with over 7 billion document images. Our major platforms and products include: DataTree®, FraudGuard®, RegsData™, TaxSource™ and ACI®. The First American Data & Analytics division boasts more than 20 patents and remains at the forefront of innovation - leveraging technology and data to deliver best-in-class decisioning solutions. Fueled by our industry-leading data and using our technology and proprietary process, our solutions provide lenders, real estate and title companies with actionable insights - enabling them to make better, increasingly automated, decisions. With offices in all major metropolitan areas, including California and New York, DNA teams work collaboratively from across the country. Since 1889, First American (NYSE: FAF) has held an unwavering belief in its people. They are passionate about what they do, and we are equally passionate about fostering an environment where all feel welcome, supported, and empowered to be innovative and reach their full potential. Our inclusive, people-first culture has earned our company numerous accolades, including being named to the Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For® list for eleven consecutive years. We have also earned awards as a best place to work for women, diversity and LGBTQ+ employees, and have been included on more than 50 regional best places to work lists. First American will always strive to be a great place to work, for all. For more information, please visit www.careers.firstam.com.

What We Do

We are seeking an accomplished Director of Property Data Sales to lead a team responsible for driving growth across our DataTree and Financial Services solutions.

This is a sales leadership role for someone who knows how to turn strategy into execution and deliver results through others. You will lead, coach, and develop a team of sales professionals while establishing the sales strategy, operating rhythm, pipeline discipline, and performance expectations needed to achieve sustainable revenue growth.

The ideal candidate combines strong commercial instincts with analytical rigor. You understand how to evaluate markets, identify growth opportunities, use data to improve sales performance, and build trusted relationships with customers and internal partners. Just as importantly, you know how to build high-performing sales teams and create an environment of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

How You'll Contribute

Lead and Develop a High-Performing Sales Team

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of sales professionals responsible for Property Data and Financial Services solutions.
  • Establish clear performance expectations and hold the team accountable for revenue, pipeline, customer, and activity goals.
  • Provide regular coaching using pipeline reviews, deal strategy discussions, performance data, and customer insights.
  • Recruit, onboard, retain, and develop strong sales talent while building bench strength and future leadership capability.
  • Identify performance gaps early and take appropriate action to improve individual and team results.
  • Create a collaborative, customer-focused sales culture that balances performance accountability with employee development.

Drive Sales Strategy and Revenue Growth

  • Develop and execute sales strategies aligned with business objectives, market opportunities, customer needs, and revenue targets.
  • Translate broader business strategy into actionable sales priorities, territory strategies, account plans, and performance expectations.
  • Identify opportunities to expand existing customer relationships, penetrate new markets, and accelerate adoption of Property Data and Financial Services solutions.
  • Maintain awareness of competitive, market, customer, and industry trends and incorporate those insights into sales strategy.
  • Partner with business leadership to evaluate emerging growth opportunities and determine where sales resources will have the greatest impact.

Strengthen Sales Execution and Performance

  • Establish a disciplined sales operating rhythm, including pipeline management, forecasting, performance reviews, and deal strategy.
  • Develop accurate and actionable sales forecasts and communicate performance, risks, opportunities, and recommended actions to leadership.
  • Use sales data and performance metrics to identify trends, diagnose gaps, and improve sales effectiveness.
  • Establish meaningful measures of sales productivity and hold the organization accountable for execution against agreed-upon goals.
  • Evaluate sales processes, tools, and practices and implement improvements that increase effectiveness, scalability, and customer impact.

Champion the Customer

  • Build a strong understanding of customer needs, business challenges, and evolving market dynamics.
  • Ensure the sales organization develops trusted, consultative relationships with customers and consistently delivers on commitments.
  • Maintain executive-level relationships with strategic customers when appropriate and support the team in navigating complex opportunities.
  • Bring customer insights back into the organization to help inform product, marketing, service, and go-to-market decisions.

Partner Across the Business

  • Collaborate closely with Product, Marketing, Operations, Customer Success, Finance, and other partners to align go-to-market priorities and support revenue growth.
  • Partner with Marketing to develop campaigns, messaging, and market strategies that build awareness and generate demand.
  • Influence across organizational boundaries to resolve customer or business challenges.
  • Lead or participate in cross-functional initiatives focused on improving sales effectiveness, customer experience, and business performance.
  • Effectively lead through change and help the sales organization adapt to evolving products, markets, customer expectations, and business priorities.

What You'll Bring

  • Bachelor's degree or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • 7+ years of progressive B2B sales experience, ideally within property data, financial services, information services, real estate technology, mortgage/title, data and analytics, or another complex solutions-based environment.
  • 3+ years of demonstrated success leading and developing sales professionals.
  • Proven ability to deliver revenue growth through a sales team rather than primarily through individual production.
  • Demonstrated success developing and executing sales strategies and translating business objectives into measurable sales plans.
  • Strong experience with sales forecasting, pipeline management, performance analytics, and sales metrics.
  • Ability to analyze sales and market data, identify trends and opportunities, and translate insights into action.
  • Experience managing complex or enterprise customer relationships and supporting teams through sophisticated sales cycles.
  • Strong business and financial acumen with an understanding of how sales decisions affect revenue, profitability, customer retention, and long-term growth.
  • Demonstrated ability to recruit, coach, develop, and retain high-performing sales talent.
  • Strong executive presence and communication skills, including the ability to clearly articulate strategy, performance, risks, and opportunities.
  • Ability to influence and build effective relationships across functions and organizational levels.
  • Comfort operating in a dynamic environment and leading teams through change.
  • Ability to travel as business needs require.

This position will be accepting applications on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Pay Range: $148,600.00 - $198,200.00 AnnuallyThis hiring range is a reasonable estimate of the base pay range for this position at the time of posting. Pay is based on a number of factors which may include job-related knowledge, skills, experience, business requirements and geographic location.

** Note that the following statements only apply to candidates who will be working from an unincorporated area within Los Angeles County. **

First American will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws (e.g., the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act).

First American intends to conduct a review of an applicant’s criminal history in connection with a conditional offer. First American reasonably believes that a criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship with the following material job duties for this position potentially resulting in the withdrawal of the conditional offer of employment: handling of confidential, proprietary or trade secret information belonging to First American or its customers, administrating or facilitating financial transactions, and the ability to meet customer-imposed criminal history requirements.

What We Offer

By choice, we don’t simply accept individuality – we embrace it, we support it, and we thrive on it! Our People First culture is inclusive for all employees - not just because it's the right thing to do, but because it's the key to our success. We are proud to foster an authentic and inclusive workplace For All. You are free and encouraged to bring your entire, unique self to work. First American is an equal opportunity employer in every sense of the term.Based on eligibility, First American offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, vision, 401k, PTO/paid sick leave and other great benefits like an employee stock purchase plan.

raw.description:
Backend Engineer

As a Backend Engineer at Techstars, you will be the connective tissue between our data infrastructure and the product teams building Techstars OS — the operating system that drives how we run accelerators, support founders, and make investment decisions. You will own our data pipelines, keep our cloud infrastructure stable and secure, and work across teams to ship reliable, observable systems. This role blends backend data engineering with platform/infrastructure work; the right person is equally comfortable building an ELT pipeline as they are debugging a Kubernetes deployment

What you will do

  • Design, build, and maintain data pipelines that ingest, transform, and serve data across Techstars systems — including Salesforce, PostgreSQL, Kafka, and internal APIs
  • Own and evolve our Kubernetes-based infrastructure (Helm, OpenTofu, Github Actions), including deployment tooling, secrets management, and cluster health
  • Partner with our senior security engineer on infrastructure reliability — incident response, observability, and proactive improvements to keep things stable
  • Maintain and improve our PostgreSQL database layer: schema design, migrations, query performance, and data integrity
  • Support Salesforce data flows and integrations with our broader platform
  • Build and maintain internal tooling and integrations that connect third-party SaaS tools to Techstars OS
  • Contribute to engineering standards: CI/CD practices, testing, code review, documentation
  • Work in an agile team environment with a product backlog, sprints, and regular delivery to production

What you bring

  • Solid experience building and maintaining data pipelines — ETL/ELT, data ingestion, transformation, and delivery to downstream consumers
  • Proficiency with PostgreSQL: schema design, migrations, query optimization, data modeling
  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes in production (AWS EKS a plus), including familiarity with Helm, kubectl, and debugging workloads
  • Experience with infrastructure-as-code tooling (OpenTofu, Terraform)
  • Strong Python skills for data engineering, scripting, and automation
  • Strong understanding of agentic development in a team environment
  • Familiarity with AWS services (S3, RDS, Lambda, IAM, and related tooling)
  • A DevOps mindset: you care about observability (Prometheus/Grafana experience a plus), reliability, and what happens after code ships
  • Excellent debugging and troubleshooting skills — you can work from symptoms to root cause on unfamiliar systems
  • Experience working in agile development environments with a product team
  • Strong communication skills — you work well across teams and can explain technical tradeoffs clearly

Nice to have

  • Experience with Salesforce data structures and CRM-adjacent integrations
  • Knowledge of financial or investment data (venture capital, startup portfolio management)
  • Familiarity with data pipeline orchestration tools (Airflow or similar)
  • Experience with JavaScript/TypeScript for backend services
  • Prior work at a startup, accelerator, or investment firm

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Compensation & Benefits

Salary Range: 115,000 - 130,000

Benefits: Techstars offers a comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) retirement plan, and paid time off.

About Techstars
Since 2006, Techstars has been investing in the world’s most ambitious founders. We find great founders early, through a global network two decades in the making, and back them with capital, mentorship, and the connections they need to grow.

Techstars is an affirmative action, equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, sex, age, national origin, religion, physical or mental handicaps or disabilities, marital status, Veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity nor any other basis prohibited by law.

Right To Work Poster (English and Spanish)

Salesforce Sales Cloud Owner – EU

As the Salesforce Sales Cloud Owner at Sysco you will play a pivotal role in shaping, governing, and delivering the strategic roadmap for the Salesforce Sales Cloud within our EU Sales Enablement Team. You will lead the long‑term vision and day‑to‑day optimisation of the platform, ensuring that Salesforce continues to evolve as a business‑critical system across multiple functions and markets. This includes driving adoption across more than 2,500 users, managing a network of Super Users, and overseeing the successful delivery of all cloud‑aligned initiatives.

You will act as the strategic owner of the cloud, partnering with stakeholders across EU and US teams to understand business needs, translate them into scalable Salesforce solutions, and ensure alignment with our EU template and governance principles. This role requires a strong blend of product ownership, leadership, and operational excellence within an Agile environment.

This position offers a remote working arrangement from anywhere within the UK or EU and occasional travel will be required.

Responsibilities

Leadership & Cloud Ownership

  • Provide line management, coaching, and development for Cloud Business Analysts.
  • Ensure structured planning, prioritisation, and control of all work entering the cloud team.
  • Proactively identify upcoming business needs and prepare the cloud roadmap accordingly.
  • Oversee the organisation of Agile activity across 26 sprints per year, ensuring smooth delivery.

Strategic Direction & Roadmap Delivery

  • Partner with business functions to gather insights, feedback, and future requirements.
  • Work with the Head of CRM to define and own the Sales Cloud roadmap aligned to EU ambitions and standardisation principles.
  • Deliver all roadmap commitments without operational disruption.
  • Define measurable KPIs for major initiatives and track benefits realisation.

Cloud Governance & Business Engagement

  • Act as the “General Manager” of the cloud, ensuring adherence to EU governance, standards, and processes.
  • Support business users with ad‑hoc queries and ensure high‑quality communication and training.
  • Manage and engage a network of 30+ CRM Super Users across EU markets.
  • Coordinate demos, training sessions, and change‑management activities to drive adoption.

About You

To succeed in this role, you will bring several years of Salesforce experience at a Product Owner or Cloud Owner level, ideally within a large, complex organisation. You will have demonstrable experience delivering Salesforce Clouds end‑to‑end and a strong understanding of Agile methodologies, including user story creation and sprint ceremonies.

You’ll have:

  • Proven experience building and implementing Salesforce solutions at scale.
  • Strong knowledge of cloud technologies, SaaS platforms, and enterprise applications.
  • Experience working in fast‑paced, high‑pressure environments.
  • A solid understanding of Salesforce Sales Cloud features and capabilities, enabling you to translate business needs into platform solutions.
  • The ability to work confidently with stakeholders at all levels, from operational teams to senior leadership.
  • Desirable experience with Jira and Microsoft Dynamics 365.

You will thrive in a role that requires strategic thinking, operational discipline, and the ability to influence and collaborate across multiple business units and geographies

What you'll get:

  • Early Access to Your Earnings: Use our dedicated Wage Stream app to access your earned salary whenever you need it, helping you manage your finances with ease and confidence.
  • Flexible Time Off: Take advantage of the option to purchase additional annual leave.
  • Comprehensive Wellbeing & Health Support: Benefit from our Employee Assistance Programme, offering confidential mental health support, 24/7 GP appointments, physiotherapy, flu vaccinations, eye tests and a wide range of health services for you and your family.
  • Competitive Pension Scheme: Secure your future with our robust pension plan designed to help you plan long term.
  • Life Assurance: Peace of mind with life assurance coverage designed to protect you and your loved ones.
  • Exclusive Discounts: Enjoy access to Sysco Perks, where you’ll find discounts on everything from gym memberships to your weekly grocery shop.
  • Special Sysco Product Discounts: Get the chance to purchase our food products at significantly reduced prices.
  • Free Mortgage Advice: Navigate the property market with confidence thanks to complimentary expert mortgage guidance.
  • Enhanced Family-Friendly Leave: Our policies support you through important life moments, offering greater flexibility and care for you and your family.

At Sysco International everyone is welcome. We don’t want you to ‘fit our culture’ we want you to help define it and we actively celebrate the unique talents of each and every colleague. We don’t just look at your CV, we’re more focused on who you are and your potential. As part of our values, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone has a voice, is appreciated and has the same opportunities. We work hard to ensure that everyone feels part of our business, as we care for one another and connect the world through food and trusted partnerships. Our ultimate goal is to ensure that everyone belongs and thrives at Sysco International and we recognise that Sysco International can only thrive when everyone feels they belong. description: The main purpose of the Designer is to work on design-related tasks for Digitalist's assigned clients and projects, with the responsibility to create quality, effective, well-designed, and impactful visual work across websites, e-commerce stores, and paid and owned marketing channels that converts and drives sales for our clients.

raw.title: Designer - Digitalist
raw.excerpt: The main purpose of the Designer is to work on design-related tasks for Digitalist's assigned clients and projects, with the responsibility to create quality, effective, well-designed, and impactful visual work across websites, e-commerce stores, and paid and owned marketing channels that converts and drives sales for our clients.
raw.description:
The main purpose of the Designer is to work on design-related tasks for Digitalist's assigned clients and projects, with the responsibility to create quality, effective, well-designed, and impactful visual work across websites, e-commerce stores, and paid and owned marketing channels that converts and drives sales for our clients.

As a Designer, you will work closely with Account Managers, developers, and specialists to conceptualize and design a variety of client deliverables. On the web side this means design concepts for WordPress and WooCommerce websites and online stores, landing pages, and conversion-focused UX and UI work that is clean to hand over to development. On the marketing side this means Facebook and Google ad creatives, email marketing designs, content marketing graphics, and social assets, all of which have to express the voice, style, look and feel, and overall design of the brand. This will involve having a deep understanding of clients' visual brand identities, communicating new ideas to the team (verbally and visually), implementing client feedback in your designs, and supporting the team throughout the design and editing process. You will need to be creative while working within the direction of your design briefs.

The Designer will report directly to the Design Lead and the Agency Director, and will also work closely with the development, marketing, and analytics sides of the team to ensure that all designs are created well and on time.

About the Role:

Mission statement:

The primary mission of our Designer is to maintain the high design standards of our company by playing an active role in the design and visual creation process across our range of clients and for our own marketing material.

As our Designer, this will include translating analysis and conversion goals into design concepts for client websites and online stores, designing performance creative and email campaigns that reflect each client's message, brand, and style, coming up with innovative design ideas, and ensuring that your work is of the highest standard and delivered on time. Our web process always starts with the goal of higher conversion and sales, so you will be designing to a commercial outcome rather than to a mood board.

General Responsibilities:

  • Creating design concepts for client websites and e-commerce stores (primarily WordPress and WooCommerce), including page templates, product and category pages, checkout flows, and landing pages, using professional design tools (including Figma)
  • Preparing clean, well-structured, developer-ready files and handovers, including responsive states, components, spacing, and typography rules, and staying available to the developers through implementation
  • Creating high-quality, on-brand creatives for Facebook Ads and Google Ads, including static, motion-lite, and iteration variants for testing
  • Designing email marketing campaigns and flows, along with content marketing and social assets, in line with each client's brand identity
  • Creating and developing visually pleasing yet marketing-oriented and effective concepts in design
  • Working from data and analysis (heatmaps, analytics, tracking findings, test results) and turning that input into design decisions that lift conversion
  • Understanding the visual brand identity of various clients and being able to advise your Account Managers on potential design ideas, improvements, and optimizations
  • Understanding and communicating design ideas (in writing, verbally, and with the use of visuals) to other team members and, when needed, to clients
  • Receiving and implementing feedback and design changes to projects you have worked on
  • Assisting Account Managers with all tasks in Figma, including implementing edits and helping to design professional reports when needed
  • Being part of a team of both expert and less experienced designers, being able to work as a group when needed, and being able to stick to deadlines and deliver high-quality finished designs on time
  • Being well-versed in current design platforms and software, and open to learning how to effectively and productively use new tools
  • Designing marketing materials for our own company's marketing efforts when needed (including blog posts, social media content, and email assets)
  • Constantly educating yourself and developing your technical skills to enhance your expertise
  • Working on various tasks, initiatives, and projects as delegated by the Design Lead
  • Continuously working to improve the design-driven results for your assigned clients
  • Keeping contact with your assigned clients, including assisting in and attending regular meetings with them alongside the Account Managers
  • Maintaining high design standards across the agency and making sure the set targets for your assigned clients are met in terms of their design requirements
  • Participating in training and skill-building sessions for the Design Team to improve skills, performance, and overall expertise
  • Participating in the Design Team's group calls
  • Continuously working to discover industry-wide best practices and standards and presenting your findings to the Design Lead and the Agency Director
  • Being available to assist with all internal design-related needs from other parts of the team
  • Directly reporting to the Design Lead and the Agency Director (in that structural order)

Position Specs:

  • Fully remote position
  • Full-time commitment, Central Europe standard office hours (Monday to Friday)
  • Fixed-rate monthly salary
  • Receive contractor status after signing our non-disclosure agreement
  • Exclusivity agreement (nullifying the possibility to work in a position of a similar nature while working for Digitalist)
  • Committing to a 30-day notice period after the first month
  • Regular performance reviews every 9-12 months, with the first one being after 3-6 months

Requirements

About you:

Profile:

The ideal candidate must be an experienced designer with an established portfolio showcasing elevated, effective, and on-brand work for a variety of clients, stores, and niches. That portfolio should show both sides of this role: website and e-commerce design that shipped and performed, and marketing creative such as ad sets and email campaigns. Having been part of a design team before is a must for this role.

The Designer should have solid experience with Figma and the Adobe Creative Suite, and should be comfortable designing for WordPress and WooCommerce builds, including an understanding of what a theme or page builder can realistically implement. Experience with Elementor or a comparable builder, basic HTML and CSS literacy, familiarity with an email platform such as Klaviyo or Mailchimp, motion or short-form video editing, and previous agency experience are all considered a plus.

The Designer must be able to act swiftly upon receiving urgent requests and be able to work consistently with high levels of accountability. The right person will be professional and also have extensive graphic design experience, as well as strong communication, presentation, organizational, time management, and interpersonal skills to effectively deliver work of high quality promptly. You will need to possess a refined aesthetic sense, strong typography skills, effective time management skills, a high level of responsiveness, and the ability to take action and work fast to implement changes and solve design-related problems.

Familiarity with tools such as Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, WordPress, Slack, a time-tracking tool, a project management tool, and the Google Workspace Suite is a must for this role. You should feel comfortable working in a remote environment. Availability, accountability, professionalism, responsiveness, and consistency are highly important factors for us, so the Designer should display these qualities when it comes to workload commitments and general availability during office hours.

Key traits for this position:

Showing great attention to detail, being organized and structured, being both big-picture and process-oriented, possessing good communication and interpersonal skills, and having a grasp of current design-related digital marketing trends and best practices in our industry. The right person will also possess strong design and typography skills with a high level of visual intelligence. You need to be able to understand your assigned clients' brand identity, style, and voice and create designs that reflect that, and you need to be comfortable being held to a conversion or sales outcome rather than only to how the work looks. The ability to use design styles consistently across various client accounts is a must. Being accountable, approachable, and well-organized is key for this role.

Key Requirements:

  • At least 5 years of experience working as a Designer in a professional role or similar experience in a design role at another agency (preference will be given to candidates who have worked with remote teams and team members from different countries, or who have agency experience)
  • An in-depth understanding and proficiency in a variety of design tools, including Figma and the Adobe Creative Suite, and a willingness to learn how to use other design tools in the future
  • Demonstrable experience designing websites and online stores that were actually built and launched, ideally on WordPress or WooCommerce
  • Demonstrable experience designing paid social and search creative, and email marketing designs
  • Experience with Elementor or a comparable page builder, basic HTML and CSS literacy, an email platform such as Klaviyo or Mailchimp, motion or short-form video editing, or previous agency experience are considered a plus
  • Having an established design portfolio showcasing elevated, effective, and on-brand designs for a variety of clients, stores, and niches
  • Must possess the ability to create designs for a variety of clients, regardless of their brand and niche
  • A refined aesthetic sense and strong typography skills to be able to create and deliver quality work
  • Have the ability to take action and work fast to implement changes and solve design-related problems
  • Must possess strong communication, presentation, organizational, time management, and interpersonal skills to effectively deliver work of high quality promptly
  • Should be able to perform both repetitive and miscellaneous tasks while maintaining a high level of accuracy in your work
  • Must be highly accountable, responsive, and have an excellent ability to meet deadlines
  • Great aptitude for working with people, problem-solving, and thinking critically and analytically
  • Must be able to work on video editing tasks, mostly for UGC content
  • Possesses a growth and results-driven mindset, and can handle and implement constructive criticism
  • Any remote work experience is a major advantage
  • Excellent interpersonal skills to clearly and effectively communicate with clients as well as with the marketing, development, and analytics people on our team
  • Familiarity with working autonomously and managing your time (remote work experience is a plus)
  • Must be available and responsive during Central Europe standard office hours, Monday to Friday
  • Must have a stable internet connection and a laptop or PC, as well as be able to attend virtual video conferences
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English (you must be fluent in English, although English does not have to be your native language)
  • Slovenian, Croatian, or Serbian is a plus given our client base, but it is not a requirement
  • Being open to receiving feedback and constructive criticism and improving on it, as well as giving feedback of a similar nature productively to your team

raw.description:
Interested in joining a growing company where you will work with talented colleagues, enhance a supportive and energetic culture, and be part of the climate solution? At Energy Solutions, we focus on the big impacts. And we believe that market-based programs can be a powerful force to deliver large-scale energy, carbon, and water-use savings. Since 1995, we’ve harnessed that power to offer proven, performance-based solutions for our utility, government, and institutional customers.

Energy Solutions is seeking a Senior Compliance Specialist who will analyze, assess, and coordinate compliance with complex regulatory, contractual, privacy, audit, operational, data security, ethics, and risk management requirements under the direction of the General Counsel and Assistant General Counsel. This non-attorney role identifies compliance obligations, evaluates business risks, and recommends practical compliance solutions for legal review and business implementation.

In this role, the Senior Compliance Specialist will be operating with a high degree of independence, conduct risk assessments, interpret contractual and regulatory requirements, support audit and governance activities, and serve as a key compliance resource across the organization. Additionally, this person will collaborate with business units, project teams, Information Security, People and Culture, Finance, and external stakeholders to support compliance with contractual obligations, privacy requirements, regulatory requirements, audit expectations, and organizational policies.

This is a perfect opportunity for someone with strong analytical judgment, critical thinking, communication, and problem-solving skills, along with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Facilitate Energy Solutions' compliance and ethics program in alignment with regulatory requirements, contractual obligations, and organizational standards.
  • Conduct compliance assessments and monitoring activities to identify potential risks, control gaps, and compliance concerns.
  • Analyze regulatory requirements, contractual obligations and changes, audit provisions, client flow-down requirements, and operational commitments to determine compliance obligations.
  • Support privacy compliance activities, including ensuring compliance with California privacy requirements and other applicable privacy regulations, and responding to consumer privacy requests.
  • Conduct preliminary assessments of security events and privacy incidents, support the Company’s response, and escalate legal interpretation questions to counsel, as needed.
  • Prepare regulatory filings, compliance reports, and audit-related documentation.
  • Assess contractual insurance requirements and coordinate company insurance coverage, renewals, certificates, and supporting documentation.
  • Develop and maintain compliance-related policies, procedures, guidance documents, and operational controls.
  • Support due diligence reviews, client questionnaires, proposal activities, and contractual compliance assessments.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in business administration, Legal Studies, Business Management, Public Policy, Risk Management, Project Management, Information Security, Compliance, or related field.
  • 8 years of experience in contractual compliance, privacy laws, risk management, audit, legal operations, regulatory operations, governance, or related professional function.
  • Experience interpreting and implementing regulatory, contractual, privacy, audit, or compliance requirements in a business environment.
  • Experience conducting compliance assessments, risk analyses, monitoring activities, audits, remediation efforts, or operational reviews.
  • Experience supporting privacy, data protection, contractual compliance, governance, or risk management programs.
  • Experience facilitating compliance activities across multiple business functions and stakeholders.
  • Experience working with clients, auditors, regulators, subcontractors, or external stakeholders regarding compliance-related matters.
  • Experience developing policies, procedures, training materials, compliance documentation, and governance controls.
  • Advanced knowledge of privacy regulations, including CCPA/CPRA and other state-related regulations and laws, privacy rights requests, data protection obligations, and privacy incident response processes.
  • Willingness to conduct limited business travel (approximately 5%).

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master's degree in business administration, Legal Studies, Public Policy, Risk Management, Regulatory Compliance, Information Security, Privacy, Project Management, or related fields.
  • Certified Information Privacy Professional (CIPP/US) is strongly preferred.
  • Certified Compliance and Ethics Professional (CCEP) preferred.
  • Certified Information Systems Auditor (CISA), Certified Internal Auditor (CIA), Certified Risk and Compliance Management Professional (CRCMP), or similar compliance, audit, or risk management certification preferred.
  • Experience administering privacy compliance programs, including privacy rights requests, privacy incidents, privacy impact assessments, and state privacy regulations.
  • Experience working with government contracts, grant-funded programs, regulatory requirements, or highly regulated contractual environments.
  • Experience supporting SOC 2, NIST, ISO, or similar governance and compliance frameworks.
  • Experience managing contract compliance programs, audit obligations, insurance requirements, reporting obligations, and client flow-down requirements.
  • Experience serving as a compliance resource and supporting compliance monitoring, governance activities, policy development, training initiatives, and organizational compliance programs.
  • Experience preparing compliance reports, audit responses, risk assessments, dashboards, executive summaries, and governance-related reporting.

The salary range for this role is $87,100 - $120,488 with a target compensation of $87,100 - $104,531 based on experience and qualifications.

Compensation is commensurate with experience and includes a generous retirement package. Energy Solutions provides an excellent benefits package including medical, dental and vision insurance, other pre-tax contribution plans and an Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP).

AI Use

At Energy Solutions we believe in the importance of authentic interactions and equitable opportunities. We base our candidate selection on one’s own skills, knowledge, and experience. To ensure the integrity and fairness of our interview process, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools (including Generative AI) or other means to generate or assist with responses during interviews is strictly prohibited. This practice supports our commitment to create a transparent and equitable space where skills, knowledge and experience can truly shine.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Energy Solutions is an affirmative action-equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type. We afford equal employment opportunities to employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristics protected by law. Energy Solutions conforms to the spirit as well as to the letter of all applicable laws and regulations.

Office Locations and a Remote Workforce

Energy Solutions operates as a predominantly remote workforce with offices in six different locations. Employees who reside within 40 miles of an office (except New York) will be assigned to that location, though in-office attendance requirements may vary by team. At this time, we are not accepting applications from candidates residing in the following states: Delaware, Kentucky, Mississippi, Montana, Nebraska, and North Dakota.

Background Check Information

Information will be requested to perform the compulsory background check. A drug screen and authorization to work in the U.S. indefinitely are preconditions of employment. Energy Solutions is an equal opportunity employer.

Reasonable Accommodations

Energy Solutions is committed to providing access and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities. Job Title: Global Marketing Director- Repatha - United States Remote

HOW MIGHT YOU DEFY IMAGINATION?

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

What you will do

Let's do this. Let's change the world. In this vital role, the Director, Global Marketing - Repatha will play a central role in shaping and executing the global commercial strategy for one of Amgen's leading cardiovascular brands. The Director will help maximize Repatha's long-term value by translating deep customer, market, clinical, access, competitive, and business insights into clear strategic choices; advancing the Global Brand Plan; and ensuring strong commercialization and execution across global markets.

Reporting to the Executive Director, Global Marketing Lead - Repatha, this role will lead major global brand priorities including VESALIUS-CV commercialization and launch readiness, lifecycle growth strategy, competitive preparedness, brand positioning and messaging, and global-to-local execution. The Director will partner closely with Global Medical, Development, Access, Regulatory, Commercial Data & Analytics, Forecasting, Finance, regional teams, affiliates, and external partners to strengthen Repatha's leadership in an increasingly dynamic LDL-C treatment landscape.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Shape and execute Repatha's global commercial strategy and Global Brand Plan, integrating customer, market, clinical, access, competitive, and financial insights into clear priorities, strategic choices, and lifecycle growth opportunities.
  • Lead commercialization and launch readiness for VESALIUS-CV and future evidence or indication expansions, ensuring new clinical evidence is translated into differentiated strategy, customer value, messaging, affiliate preparation, and measurable market impact.
  • Own and evolve Repatha's global customer and brand strategy, including priority customer segments, patient and HCP journeys, behavioral objectives, positioning, value proposition, strategic narrative, and core messaging as the market and competitive landscape evolve.
  • Lead competitive strategy and preparedness across current and emerging LDL-C therapies, identifying market inflection points and translating competitive intelligence into proactive strategic responses, affiliate guidance, and business recommendations.
  • Drive global-to-local execution by partnering with regional and affiliate teams to integrate market insight, establish clear strategic guardrails, enable appropriate local adaptation, and scale best practices across priority markets.
  • Lead highly matrixed cross-functional teams and major strategic workstreams, aligning Commercial, Medical, Development, Access, Regulatory, Commercial Data & Analytics, Forecasting, Finance, regions, affiliates, agencies, and other partners around shared priorities, decisions, timelines, and accountability.
  • Use customer, market, performance, and financial evidence to optimize strategy and investment, establish meaningful KPIs, identify execution gaps, and recommend resource and investment tradeoffs to maximize long-term brand value.
  • Champion innovative and AI-enabled ways of working across insight generation, competitive intelligence, content development, performance measurement, and global-to-local workflows while ensuring appropriate judgment, accuracy, compliance, and business relevance.

Expected travel (domestic and international) is 20%

Win

What we expect of you

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The marketing leader we seek is a strategic, customer-focused, and collaborative leader with these qualifications.

Basic Qualifications:

Doctorate degree and 4 years of marketing experience

OR

Master’s degree and 7 years of marketing experience

OR

Bachelor’s degree and 9 years of marketing experience

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Substantial commercial and marketing experience of increasing scope and complexity, ideally within biopharmaceuticals, healthcare, or another highly regulated environment.

  • Demonstrated success developing and executing global brand, commercialization, launch, or lifecycle growth strategies, with experience translating strategy into strong market execution.
  • Strong strategic marketing foundation with demonstrated ability to synthesize customer, clinical, market, competitive, access, and business evidence into clear strategic choices and recommendations.
  • Experience leading global or complex cross-functional teams in a matrix environment, building alignment across senior stakeholders, regions, and affiliate markets and influencing effectively without direct authority.
  • Experience with customer segmentation, positioning, messaging, customer journeys, behavioral objectives, Global Brand Planning, launch readiness, or integrated customer engagement.
  • Ability to interpret clinical evidence and understand the commercial implications of evolving treatment landscapes; cardiovascular, lipid management, or related therapeutic-area experience is strongly valued but not required.
  • Experience with global-to-local marketing, including working across cultures and markets, integrating affiliate insights, balancing global consistency with local relevance, and scaling best practices.
  • Experience with forecasting, long-range planning, budgeting, KPI frameworks, performance optimization, and AI- or digitally enabled marketing capabilities; MBA or other relevant advanced degree is valued.

  • Marketing competencies further developed through the role

    This role provides recurring opportunities to deepen Lifecycle Management, Brand Positioning, Financial Acumen, and Harnessing AI Capabilities through global brand leadership, lifecycle and competitive strategy, commercialization, and cross-market execution.

Thrive

What you can expect of us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for our teammates’ professional and personal growth and well-being.

In addition to the base salary, Amgen offers a Total Rewards Plan comprising health and welfare plans for staff and eligible dependents, financial plans with opportunities to save towards retirement or other goals, work/life balance, and career development opportunities including:

  • Comprehensive employee benefits package, including a Retirement and Savings Plan with generous company contributions, group medical, dental and vision coverage, life and disability insurance, and flexible spending accounts.
  • A discretionary annual bonus program, or for field sales representatives, a sales-based incentive plan
  • Stock-based long-term incentives
  • Award-winning time-off plans and bi-annual company-wide shutdowns
  • Flexible work models, including remote work arrangements, where possible

Apply now for a career that defies imagination

Objects in your future are closer than they appear. Join us.

careers.amgen.com

Application Deadline

Amgen does not have an application deadline for this position; we will continue accepting applications until we receive a sufficient number or select a candidate for the position.

Sponsorship for this role is not guaranteed.

As an organization dedicated to improving the quality of life for people around the world, Amgen fosters an inclusive environment of diverse, ethical, committed and highly accomplished people who respect each other and live the Amgen values to continue advancing science to serve patients.
