raw.description:
Nosso Modo de Fazer no Time:

Transforme sua carreira com o iFood! Somos uma empresa brasileira de tecnologia referência na América Latina. Por meio de soluções inovadoras, conectamos milhares de restaurantes a milhões de consumidores diariamente com uma média de 100 milhões de pedidos mensais. Além do delivery de comida, também somos Mercado, Farmácia e Pet. Temos também o iFood Pago, nossa Fintech, que engloba o iFood Benefícios, o vale alimentação e refeição do iFood e o próprio iFood Pago, o banco do restaurante. Junte-se a nós e faça parte de uma equipe que está sempre à frente com tecnologia de ponta e inovação constante.

Seu Cardápio Diário:

  • Coordenar e priorizar testes de segurança em aplicações baseadas em LLMs, incluindo cenários de prompt injection, jailbreak, vazamento de dados, abuso de ferramentas e manipulação de contexto.
  • Supervisionar a execução de casos de teste em agentes internos e user-facing, garantindo alinhamento com os playbooks definidos pelo time.
  • Liderar a evolução de suítes de testes e ferramentas, como Promptfoo ou equivalentes, promovendo inovação e eficiência.
  • Monitorar e analisar alertas e sinais gerados por controles como LLM Firewall, guardrails, Anonymizer e AI Gateway, garantindo respostas rápidas e eficazes.
  • Validar e revisar testes funcionais e de regressão em serviços e controles de AI Security, assegurando a qualidade e a segurança das entregas.
  • Orientar análises de logs, métricas e eventos relacionados ao tráfego de LLMs, agentes e plataformas internas, identificando padrões e oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Gerenciar a identificação de falsos positivos, falsos negativos e propor melhorias em regras, heurísticas e políticas de detecção.
  • Revisar e aprovar análises de segurança em MCPs, skills e ferramentas utilizadas por desenvolvedores ou agentes.
  • Garantir a segurança de artefatos de ML, supply chain e quality gates em pipelines, promovendo boas práticas e conformidade.
  • Documentar e revisar achados técnicos, evidências, FAQs, guias, playbooks e boas práticas, assegurando clareza e aplicabilidade.
  • Promover iniciativas de educação, awareness, CTFs, meetups, pesquisa aplicada e consolidação de referências técnicas, fortalecendo a cultura de segurança no time e na organização.

Ingredientes Que Buscamos:

  • Experiência sólida em segurança da informação, desenvolvimento de software, infraestrutura ou áreas correlatas.
  • Conhecimento avançado em APIs, HTTP, autenticação, autorização, logs e análise de eventos.
  • Proficiência em pelo menos uma linguagem de programação, preferencialmente Python, Go ou JavaScript/TypeScript.
  • Experiência com Git, GitLab/GitHub, pipelines CI/CD e leitura de código.
  • Interesse e conhecimento em Inteligência Artificial, LLMs, agentes, Machine Learning ou segurança aplicada à IA.
  • Capacidade de transformar aprendizados técnicos em estratégias, testes, checklists ou recomendações acionáveis.
  • Excelência na comunicação escrita e verbal para documentar e apresentar testes, achados, evidências e recomendações.
  • Atenção a detalhes em análises de logs, permissões, prompts, configurações e fluxos de dados.
  • Liderança técnica, curiosidade e capacidade de evoluir continuamente com base em feedback e aprendizado.
  • Responsabilidade ao lidar com dados sensíveis, credenciais, ambientes internos e resultados de testes de segurança.

Para Realçar o Sabor:

  • Experiência acadêmica, projetos pessoais ou atuação em segurança, IA, dados ou engenharia de software.
  • Conhecimento sobre OWASP Top 10, OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications ou conceitos de threat modeling.
  • Familiaridade com cenários de ataque como prompt injection, jailbreaks, data leakage, tool abuse ou ataques contra aplicações LLM.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de teste, automação, scripting ou organização de evidências.
  • Conhecimento em MCP, skills, agentes, AI gateways, token exchange ou propagação de identidade.
  • Interesse em ML Security, supply chain de modelos, segurança de datasets, dependências ou artefatos de Machine Learning.
  • Participação em CTFs, comunidades técnicas, grupos de pesquisa, meetups ou iniciativas de escrita técnica.

Buscamos uma pessoa apaixonada por segurança e inovação tecnológica, que esteja sempre em busca de novos aprendizados e que goste de desafios. Se você se identifica com este perfil, adoraríamos conhecer você!

We are particularly interested in candidates with experience in skilled nursing facilities (SNF), acute inpatient settings, discharge planning, community resource coordination, or hospice care. If this sounds like your next career move, apply today and join us in helping members achieve better health outcomes and improved quality of life.

Note:

Position Description & Requirements
WHO WE ARE AND WHAT WE DO:
Radiology Partners is the largest and fastest growing physician led, physician owned radiology practice in the United States. We are transforming radiology by advancing clinical value, pioneering technology, redefining service, and reshaping the economics of imaging to elevate the role of radiologists and improve care for every patient we touch. RP Clinical Services (RPCS) is the clinical engine of the practice—the enterprise platform that brings our service lines, physician operating units, and partner relationships together into a single, high-performing organization built to deliver exceptional outcomes for patients, breakthrough value for clients, and meaningful, sustainable careers for physicians.
The Office of the COO sits at the center of that operating model, where strategy becomes execution. The Chief of Staff is a trusted extension of the COO, helping translate the RPCS operating agenda into action across operations, physician, and support teams so that decisions are made, commitments are kept, and the most important work moves forward.
Radiology Partners is seeking a Chief of Staff to serve as a strategic force multiplier and trusted partner to the Chief Operating Officer (COO), RP Clinical Services. The COO holds a builder’s seat— accountable for the day-to-day performance, growth, and continuous improvement of RPCS practices, markets, and physician operating units. The Chief of Staff extends the reach of the COO by translating operating strategy into execution across operations, physician, and support teams—ensuring decisions are made, commitments are kept, and priorities move forward with speed and clarity, including making informed decisions on the COO’s behalf when the COO is unavailable.
VP, OPERATIONS (CHIEF OF STAFF) - POSITION SUMMARY:
  • Partner closely with the COO to define, sequence, and execute the RPCS operating agenda—translating the President’s strategy and the COO’s priorities into measurable outcomes for patients, clients, physicians, and the enterprise.
  • Represent the COO and Act in the Executive’s Absence: Attend meetings alongside and on behalf of the COO, take action on agreed priorities, and make timely, well-reasoned decisions within delegated authority when the COO is unavailable—escalating only what genuinely requires the executive’s input.
  • Drive Execution of Growth and Operating Priorities: Actively move the COO’s top initiatives forward—market expansion, client commitments, new service lines, and operating-model improvements—anticipating needs, removing blockers, and tracking milestones to completion.
  • Operating Cadence and Business Reviews: Establish and run a transparent operating cadence— scorecards, business reviews, decision logs, and forums that surface performance, escalate risk early, and accelerate decision-making across markets and practices.
  • Physician Engagement: Build credible, trusted relationships with radiologists and physician leaders; represent the physician perspective in operating decisions and help make RPCS the premier home for physicians.
  • Support Team Leadership and Collaboration: Work seamlessly with operations, enterprise shared services, and support teams to coordinate execution, remove friction, and keep cross-functional work aligned to RPCS priorities .
DESIRED PROFESSIONAL SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Healthcare Administration, Operations, or a related field.
  • 7–10+ years of progressive experience in operations, strategy, program/project management, or a Chief of Staff / senior advisory role, including at least 5 years of leadership or management experience.
  • Demonstrated experience partnering with senior executives and influencing cross-functional teams in a multi-site or matrixed environment. Understanding of healthcare and/or radiology operations, physician practice dynamics, multi-site operating models, and the regulatory environment in which Radiology Partners operates.
  • Operating cadences, business-review and scorecard disciplines, and project/program management principles.
  • Comfort operating in ambiguity and bringing structure, clarity, and momentum to loosely defined problems.
  • Strong independent judgment and the ability to make decisions, escalate appropriately, and drive outcomes with limited direction.
  • Ability to work with confidential information and represent senior leadership with credibility, maturity, executive presence, and a general athlete mindset.
FOR MORE INFORMATION:
VP, Operations - Chief of Staff

WHY RADIOLOGY PARTNERS:

  • Partner directly with the COO of the clinical engine of the largest, fastest growing physician led radiology practice in the United States.
  • Sit at a builder’s seat, helping define and scale the RPCS operating model at a true inflection point of scale, technology, and growth.
  • Gain broad exposure across markets, practices, operations, innovation, and the patient and client experience.
  • Work alongside bold, forward-thinking physician and executive leaders who expect excellence, value collaboration, and back their people to win. Competitive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package
  • Flexible Remote Schedules - Nashville, TN Preferred

Final determinations may vary based on several factors including but not limited to education, work experience, certifications, geographic location etc. This role is also eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. In addition to this range, Radiology Partners offers competitive total rewards packages, which include health & wellness coverage options, 401k benefits, and a broad range of other benefits such as family planning and telehealth (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements).
Radiology Partners is an equal opportunity employer. We are united by our Mission to Transform Radiology and in turn have an important impact on the patients we serve and the healthcare system overall. Our goal is to empower and engage the voice of every teammate to promote awareness, compassion and a healthy respect for differences.

Become a part of our caring community

Healthcare is rapidly changing, and our members are living longer, often with more chronic conditions. Consumers expect more personalized and holistic experiences from their health partners. Humana is committed to innovation to create new approaches and optimize existing assets to improve member experiences and health outcomes through better integrating Humana’s clinical capabilities, processes, and technology. This role will be instrumental in defining and executing on the vision of our transition to being a more health outcomes-oriented organization that also strengthens the financial performance of the business in partnership with leaders and teams across Humana.

The AVP, Clinical Program and Product Strategy is a senior leadership role at the center of this transformation. This leader will design, test, and scale new cross-functional approaches to clinical programs and products that measurably improve the experience, clinical outcomes, and total cost of care for our members. Working at the intersection of clinical strategy, product, and operations, the AVP will translate ambitious clinical priorities into pilots, launch them with rigor, and scale what works across the enterprise.
This is a challenging, highly visible role that demands the ability to navigate ambiguity, align many stakeholders around a shared vision, and deliver results in a complex, matrixed environment. It is also one of the most impactful roles on the team as it directly shapes how Humana improves health outcomes and lowers costs for millions of members.

Our team within Clinical Innovation & Trend employs a rigorous process to set specific clinical priorities for the enterprise, identify the greatest sources of value, and lead a multi-disciplinary process to identify discrete opportunities for enhanced clinical outcomes, cost control, quality, and member experience. The AVP, Clinical Program and Product Strategy will lead a substantial portion of this work as they own the end-to-end journey from clinical strategy through program and product design, implementation, and scaling.


Use your skills to make an impact

Responsibilities include:

  • Drive enterprise-wide clinical strategy: play a leadership role on a team that develops and executes on enterprise-wide clinical strategies that drive improved health outcomes for our members.
  • Lead clinical program and product design, implementation, and scaling by owning the full lifecycle from concept and pilot design through launch, and then maintaining strategic oversight as programs are scaled to ensure continuous improvement and sustained impact.
  • Clinical program and intervention scope includes near to medium term value delivery of across digital health partnerships strategy and execution, Stars clinical strategy and interventions for key HEDIS measures (GSD / CBP and Care Coordination), and specialty strategy in key high-cost specialties (oncology, CV, MSK, kidney care, etc.).
  • In addition, this leader is responsible for driving the evolution our long-term approach to integrated clinical products to deeply understand member needs and create a differentiated clinical experience and outcomes and cost impact.
  • Lead both the team directly and drive deep collaboration with partner teams across the enterprise, uniting business leaders, clinicians, product managers, analytics, engineering, and design around common goals.
  • Work across the organization in a multidisciplinary way to lead strategic partners across the enterprise, including business leaders, clinicians, and analytics experts, to develop strategies for complex clinical programs.
  • Influence others across the organization to ensure enterprise-wide efforts are coordinated, focused on the highest-value opportunities, and take advantage of synergies that occur when multiple teams with different skillsets and scopes come together for common goals.
  • Design, test, and scale new cross-functional approaches that improve the experience, clinical outcomes, and cost of care for members, building repeatable capabilities and operating models that outlast any single initiative.
  • Provide strategic input, updates, and presentations to enterprise-wide forums.
  • Influence senior decision-makers at Humana on opportunities to improve health, lower costs, and improve experience for members, providers, and associates.
  • Exercise independent judgment and decision making on complex issues and bring others along with them.

Required Qualifications

  • MD or DO degree
  • 10+ years of strategy and operations development and implementation experience for healthcare-related organizations.
  • Clinical operations experience and expertise, including a deep understanding of how care is delivered across payers and providers, and especially the intersection between the two.
  • Product experience managing multidisciplinary teams, including analytics, engineering, design, and clinical roles, to build and scale programs or products.
  • Strong business and/or consulting experience.
  • Solid business and financial acumen.
  • Experience with analytics and use of data.
  • Experience leading cross-functional teams to execute on complex projects.
  • Process improvement experience.
  • Ability to influence, establish, and drive improved business outcomes.
  • Ability to lead a diverse group of people toward a common vision with proven results related to motivation, engagement, and goal attainment.

Role Responsibilities

  • Source documents: Find a publicly accessible Odia PDF in an assigned document type with multimodal elements. Record the source.

  • Comfort with unfamiliar layouts like multi-column newspapers and handwritten forms.

Preferred

  • Experience with regional-language AI data annotation, labeling, grading, or bilingual evaluation.
  • Skills in transcription and localization: MTPE, subtitling, bilingual QA, OCR correction, or post-editing.
  • Document production skills: typesetting, copy-editing, proofreading, or digitization of Odia-language material.

What are we looking for?

At AIS, we're looking for more than just skills - we're looking for driven individuals who are passionate about making a difference, eager to grow, and aligned with our core principles.

Working@AIS

At AIS, we are dedicated to providing our employees with diverse opportunities to grow their careers while supporting a variety of impactful projects. For this position, we are seeking a talented individual to join AIS as a Lead Infrastructure Engineer.

  • Core Knowledge & Skills: Aligns infrastructure strategy to business goals, leads large projects, applies compliance frameworks, designs high availability/disaster recovery and performance optimization patterns, and shapes deployment pipeline design.

  • Work & Complexity: Directs cross-team programs, performs advanced tuning, implements high availability/failover architectures, leads audits, plans growth, and manages budgets.

  • Quality & Independence: Delivers high-quality outcomes, sets team standards, introduces innovative solutions, and makes high-impact decisions.

  • Teamwork & Communication: Leads the engineering team, develops talent, resolves conflicts, and communicates effectively with senior leadership and stakeholders.

  • Consulting & Engagement: Provides high-level consulting to leadership, builds roadmaps, negotiates vendor contracts, and sponsors innovation initiatives.

As your initial project assignment, you will support the unique needs of our client as a Senior Azure Virtual Desktop Engineer.

Project Summary

AIS is seeking a Senior Azure Virtual Desktop Engineer to design, build, and optimize secure Azure Virtual Desktop environments that provide a dependable user experience for Codex-enabled development and broader virtual desktop modernization for a federal customer.

Key Responsibilities

  • Engineer AVD host pools, session hosts, images, scaling plans, application delivery, and user profiles.

  • Create secure desktop patterns for Codex access, including the required network segmentation, firewall rules, browser and developer-tool controls.

  • Implement and support FSLogix, Entra ID, Intune, profile storage, image lifecycle, and monitoring integrations.

  • Plan and execute Citrix transition activities, performance validation, capacity planning, and user acceptance testing.

  • Troubleshoot performance, sign-in, profile, application, network, and graphics issues across the AVD stack.

Company Introduction:

Airspace is a tech-enabled freight forwarder that’s redefining how the world’s most critical packages are delivered. Headquartered in Carlsbad, California, Airspace has employees who are based around the world. Our European headquarters is in Amsterdam, The Netherlands.

As a recognized leader in AI and machine learning, our team leverages data and patented technology to coordinate logistics across a global network of drivers and airlines. Our goal is to deliver those packages that are truly mission-critical in a way that is faster, more transparent, more secure, and more accountable than ever before. The items we deliver range from organs for transplant, to parts for critical machinery including grounded aircraft and highly sensitive components such as semiconductors.

Airspace has been rated one of America’s best Startup Employers and listed as one of CNBC’s Disruptor 50 companies. Airspace has the support of leading investors such as Telstra Ventures, HarbourVest Partners, Defy Partners, DBL Partners, and Scale Ventures. To date the company has raised more than $140m.

The company is growing rapidly and serving more places around the world than ever before. We are looking for passionate, motivated individuals who want to make an IMPACT every day to help us execute on our mission of reshaping the world of time-critical logistics.

What is the "Dedicated Driver" service?

Airspace partners with leading U.S. Medical Device companies to ensure life-saving equipment is transported safely and securely to hospitals in the local region. If a loved one suffers a serious injury, our Dedicated Drivers are the critical link between warehouses and hospitals, delivering essential surgical tools in real time. Their mission is clear: to equip surgeons with the critical tools for life-saving procedures—because every second counts when a patient is on the table.

About the job:

The Senior Operations Coordinator is the administrative and documentation backbone for the DD Operational Support Team, primarily supporting the Manager of Operational Support, with additional support for Talent Acquisition Specialists and Regional Managers as capacity allows. This role keeps recruiting, onboarding, and training running on schedule by owning scheduling logistics, candidate and training records, and documentation upkeep. It also supports Regional Managers with performance administration, including metrics tracking, coaching documentation, and PIP paperwork. Reporting to the Manager, DD Operational Support, this role sits alongside recruiting and support functions within the DD Operational Support Team.

This is a detail-oriented, process-driven role best suited for someone who is organized, discreet with sensitive information, and comfortable managing recurring documentation and scheduling cycles across multiple stakeholders at once.

As the Dedicated Driver program continues to grow, this role is expected to grow with it. The responsibilities outlined here represent the current scope, and the right candidate should be comfortable taking on new tasks and workflows as the team's needs develop over time.

What you'll do:

  • Coordinate interview scheduling and candidate pipeline logistics, including maintaining and updating candidate records, in partnership with the Talent Acquisition Specialists, keeping candidates moving through the hiring process without delay
  • Support the Talent Acquisition Specialist with candidate interviews as needed, which may include screening calls or sitting in on interview panels
  • Confirm new drivers' account setup and onboarding requirements are fully complete before their start date
  • Help the team track and maintain driver performance metrics and dedicated driver department reports, flagging trends and outliers that warrant attention
  • Monitor shared email queues and route inquiries to the appropriate team member as needed
  • Draft and send mass communications to drivers on an as needed basis such as emails, text blasts, or newsletters
  • Organize documentation storage and confirm naming conventions are followed consistently across recruiting, training, and performance records
  • Monitor live Dedicated Driver orders in real time, checking for order and app milestone accuracy as shipments move through each stage
  • Partner directly with the Talent Acquisition Specialist, Onboarding & Training Manager, and Regional Managers to understand upcoming scheduling and documentation needs, preparing materials in advance of deadlines
  • Escalate documentation gaps, missed deadlines, or inconsistencies to the Manager, DD Operational Support Team
  • Maintain confidentiality and sound judgment when handling sensitive candidate and personnel information
  • Order and coordinate shipment of driver equipment (e.g. uniforms, badges, placards)
  • Support curriculum updates by identifying training gaps and routing them to the training owner for revision
  • Serve as a secondary owner of training/certification tracking, capable of stepping into training program ownership during transitions
  • Take on ad hoc administrative tasks and projects for the broader DD Team as they arise
  • Support onboarding and training of new Operations Coordinators on recruiting, training, and performance documentation workflows
  • Identify and recommend improvements to scheduling processes, training tracking, workflows, and documentation templates
  • Serve as the point of escalation for complex or ambiguous scheduling or documentation cases before they reach the Manager, DD Operational Support
  • Support a larger scope across recruiting, training, and Regional Manager needs with greater autonomy and less day-to-day oversight
  • Assist with building or updating reports as reporting needs and issues arise

As the role evolves, additional responsibilities may include:

  • Supporting additional administrative needs as the program and client base expands
  • Assisting with reporting and performance visibility tools for the DD Operational Support team
  • Investigate and resolve weekly driver pay discrepancies, coordinating with Regional Managers and other systems of record as needed
  • Taking on additional Salesforce-based processes as they are developed and documented

Success Metrics

This year: what does success look like in this role this year?

  • Recruiting, onboarding, and training cycles run on schedule with minimal escalations to the Manager, DD Operational Support
  • Candidate and training records are consistently accurate and up to date
  • Performance documentation (coaching notes, performance cases) is complete, filed on time, and audit-ready
  • Order/milestone monitoring catches discrepancies before they affect customer visibility

Next year: what does success look like in this role next year?

  • Demonstrated ownership of a larger or more complex caseload with less oversight
  • Contributing process improvements to scheduling, training tracking, or documentation workflows
  • Successfully onboarding and mentoring new Operations Coordinators

Your First 90 Days

  • Learn the DD corporate support team's systems (Salesforce, ATS, LMS) and current documentation workflows
  • Shadow and take over recruiting/onboarding scheduling logistics with the Talent Acquisition Specialist and Onboarding & Training Manager
  • Begin supporting one or more Regional Managers with performance documentation and metrics tracking
  • Build working relationships with key stakeholders (Talent Acquisition Specialist, Onboarding & Training Manager, Regional Managers, Manager of DD Operational Support)

Your First 180 Days

  • Independently manage the full recruiting/onboarding coordination cycle with minimal guidance
  • Own PIP and coaching documentation from initiation through close for assigned Regional Managers
  • Reliably monitor live orders/milestones and flag discrepancies proactively
  • Identify at least one process or documentation improvement to bring to the team

What we're looking for:

  • 3+ years of experience in an administrative, coordinator, or operations support role, ideally supporting recruiting, training, or field management functions
  • Strong attention to detail, particularly when managing schedules, candidate records, and performance data
  • Comfortable working in Salesforce (SFDC), an ATS, or an LMS, or eager to learn; prior experience with any of these is a plus
  • Excellent written communication skills; able to coordinate across multiple stakeholders and summarize data clearly
  • Reliable and self-directed, with a proactive communication style when issues arise
  • Able to work within a remote, cross-timezone team environment
  • Discreet and trustworthy when handling confidential candidate and personnel information
  • Comfortable juggling competing priorities across recruiting, training, and performance support
  • Demonstrated ability to manage a higher volume or more complex caseload with minimal oversight
  • Experience mentoring or supporting the ramp-up of junior team members
  • Track record of identifying and improving administrative processes, scheduling workflows, or documentation systems
  • Comfortable acting as an escalation point and exercising independent judgment on ambiguous cases

Compensation & Benefits:

  • Salary Range: $65,000-$75,000/yr + 10% Bonus
  • High-quality health, dental, and vision plan options
  • Open PTO
  • 401K with company match
  • Professional learning and training reimbursements

Core Values:

  • We are One Team. We believe we all accomplish more when we are working together.
  • We make an Impact. We are determined to have a positive influence on our environment, our customers, our industry, and our world.
  • We are Passionate. We care deeply about our mission and are not afraid to raise the bar.
  • We are Transparent. We pride ourselves on having open, honest, and sincere communication with our team and customers.
  • We are Innovative. We never settle and are always striving to improve our product, service, and ourselves.

Position Summary

The Senior Cybersecurity Engineer is responsible for the management and maintenance of our cybersecurity infrastructure and operations and owns the technical execution and day-to-day maturity of our security tooling and processes, doing their due diligence to protect our IT systems and data. This role involves identifying vulnerabilities, leading incident response, and owning digital forensics and e-discovery work. This position will collaborate with IT leadership and various departments to support cybersecurity-related projects and provide technical guidance. Additionally, the role requires maintaining detailed documentation of cybersecurity systems and processes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Identify, implement, and manage a solid cybersecurity infrastructure to protect IT systems and data
  • Monitor security systems and identify vulnerabilities to ensure high security and compliance; assist with tuning platform settings to reduce false positives and improve escalation quality
  • Lead digital forensics, incident response, and e-discovery requests
  • Administer and maintain the data classification, sensitivity labeling, and DLP program, adapting policies as business needs evolve
  • Lead third-party vendor security evaluations, prioritizing and tracking remediation
  • Lead cross-team collaboration on cybersecurity projects and initiatives
  • Provide technical support and guidance to end-users and other IT staff
  • Own and maintain documentation of cybersecurity systems, processes, and procedures
  • Lead regular IT Security reports and audits of access controls
  • Own and ensure proper data encryption and security in all stages of data storage and transit
  • Own and ensure compliance standards are in place in systems, networks, and endpoint management
  • Travel to company locations quarterly, as needed
  • Perform other related duties as required and assigned

Required Qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience in IT engineering or cybersecurity
  • Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP) certification
  • Strong knowledge and practice of cybersecurity principles, technologies, and best practices applied to IT infrastructure and network systems
  • Proven experience leading incident response, digital forensics, and e-discovery
  • Hands-on experience administering and maintaining data classification and DLP programs (e.g., Microsoft 365 compliance suite or equivalent)

Work Environment & Physical Requirements

  • Specific vision abilities required include close vision and the ability to adjust focus for extended periods of screen-based work, including reviewing logs, audit reports, and forensic data
  • Must be able to communicate clearly and effectively via phone, video conference, and email with IT staff, department leaders, and third-party vendors, including the ability to explain technical security concepts to non-technical audiences
  • Requires quarterly travel to company locations as needed, which may include time-sensitive travel in response to a security incident requiring on-site presence

Overview of the role:

PolicyMe is building a simpler, more affordable insurance experience for Canadian families. Our website is where customers learn, build trust, and take the next step toward coverage. We’re hiring a Marketing Designer, Web to raise the visual quality of that experience. You’ll design, improve, and maintain our marketing site built using Webflow; turn Growth briefs into polished, component-led pages; and own quality through launch. Most of your work will be web and CMS-based, with select opportunities to support campaign creative, slides, ads, email UI, and other brand assets.

This is not a product-design, UX-research, or front-end developer role. We need a strong visual designer with exceptional judgment in typography, hierarchy, layout, responsive design, and the details that make a page feel considered. You don’t need to be a Webflow expert on day one: CMS fluency, good technical judgment, and an appetite to learn matter more.

What you'll be doing:

    Design and ship great marketing web experiences

  • Turn Growth and Content briefs into polished Figma designs for landing pages, product pages, editorial hubs, and campaigns.
  • Build clear, conversion-aware, accessible, and responsive layouts using our design system and existing components.
  • Design new components when needed, extending our design system in a cohesive, reusable way.
  • Improve the marketing site’s everyday surfaces, including navigation, templates, content modules, and EN/FR experiences (French language is not required) with the same care as major launches.
  • Bring a point of view to how PolicyMe shows up visually. As a startup, you’ll have meaningful input into the evolution of our web and marketing design identity, in partnership with Growth and Design leadership.

    • Own CMS quality and publishing

  • Learn and use our CMS and Webflow environment to build, update, and publish pages.
  • Own pre- and post-launch quality: responsive checks, visual QA, content and link validation, localization review, and clear resolution of inconsistencies.
  • Maintain and improve reusable Figma and CMS components, templates, and guardrails so the team can ship faster without compromising quality.

    • Lead implementation with development agencies

  • Create complete handoffs for Webflow/development partners, covering interaction states, edge cases, annotations, and walkthroughs.
  • Manage design feedback through implementation and ensure launched work matches the intended experience.
  • Coordinate with Growth, Content, Design, and Engineering to clarify scope, surface dependencies, and keep projects moving.

    • Be involved in Growth’s broader creative work

  • Support selected needs across campaign creative, ads, slide templates, email UI, illustrations, and other marketing assets.
  • Use AI design tools—including Claude Design—to explore quickly, create wireframes and variations, and improve production speed, while applying strong human judgment to every final output.

What we are looking for:

    Need to have’s:

  • 2–4 years of experience in marketing, web, brand, or related digital design. Exceptional portfolios matter more than an exact number of years.
  • A portfolio made up of highly polished marketing websites or landing pages, plus evidence of breadth across formats such as campaign work, motion, illustration, presentations, ads, or email.
  • Excellent Figma skills and a sharp eye for typography, spacing, composition, hierarchy, image selection, and responsive behaviour.
  • Experience in a CMS or no-code/low-code site builder. Webflow experience is welcome, not required.
  • The ability to work within and thoughtfully extend an existing component system—not simply make one-off pages.
  • A meticulous, reliable approach to quality and a willingness to own both high-visibility launches and routine CMS/site-maintenance work.
  • Clear communication: you can write useful specs, give developers actionable feedback, and work effectively with non-design partners.
  • Comfort juggling concurrent requests, making practical trade-offs, and using AI tools to increase speed without lowering the craft bar.

    • Nice to have’s:

  • Webflow experience, including CMS collections, global components, slots and variables, responsive page building, or publishing workflows.
  • Basic HTML/CSS literacy.
  • Experience briefing, reviewing, or QAing agency or freelance developer work.
  • Experience in a high-trust, regulated, consumer-facing, or content-heavy business.
  • Familiarity with accessibility, localization, SEO-aware content templates, or conversion-oriented web design.

Why join us:

  • Generous PTO - 20 vacation days
  • A comprehensive benefits plan with premiums paid in full by PolicyMe
  • Investment in your professional development, including an L&D budget, AI tooling budget, performance reviews twice a year and ongoing feedback to ensure you reach your highest potential
  • An extremely high performing, low-ego, remote-first team that is truly disrupting an old industry
  • Option to work from home or our Toronto-based office (bonus: we cover the costs to bring all our employees in-person twice a year for experiential socials!)
  • Access to stock options based on performance
  • Compensation: The total target cash compensation for this role is $95,000–$115,000 CAD, based on experience. We’ll walk through the details together during the interview.

About PolicyMe:

At PolicyMe, we are Canada’s leading digital insurance solution, offering straightforward and affordable financial protection for families from coast to coast. Our product suite includes Life Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, and Health & Dental Insurance, all tailored to Canadians' evolving needs. We also offer B2B2C solutions, partnering with organizations to provide seamless digital insurance options. Founded by a team of insurance experts and technology entrepreneurs, PolicyMe is committed to making insurance simpler and more accessible. Since our launch in 2018, we have grown exponentially, selling over $10 billion in insurance coverage to Canadians.

We are proud of the team we’ve built and are excited for those that are yet to join us. We operate with a remote-first culture, attracting top talent from across Canada. If you’re looking for a fast-paced, collaborative environment, working alongside incredibly ambitious yet humble humans, we may be the right place for you! To learn more, visit .

Additional Notes:

  • Job Vacancy: This role reflects growth in our team and expanded operational scope. We’re hiring to support increasing demand and continue delivering an exceptional customer experience.
  • Commitment to Equal Opportunity: PolicyMe is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and provide fair consideration regardless of race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or disability.
  • Accessibility Statement: We are committed to providing an accessible hiring experience. If you require accommodations during the application process, please indicate this in the “Additional Information” section of your application.

At ARKANCE US, we empower design, engineering, construction, and manufacturing teams to work smarter, deliver stronger outcomes, and build a better world. We believe that when great people come together around a shared purpose and set of values, we create lasting value for our customers, our communities, and each other.

Job Description Summary

Position Overview:
The Lead Data Engineer is a senior delivery role responsible for building and delivering the data engineering work that turns ARKANCE's data and AI direction into working reality for clients. Where the advisory team shapes what a client should do, this role builds it: the pipelines, models, integrations, and data foundations that make data and AI usable in practice.
The Lead Data Engineer works on both sides of the business. On the client side, they lead the hands-on delivery of data engineering across engagements, taking direction from the advisory team and producing solutions that hold up in production. Internally, they help build the frameworks, templates, and reusable assets that let ARKANCE deliver this work consistently and at scale, shaping both the internal data capability of the practice and the client-facing delivery approaches it relies on.
As a lead, the role sets the technical standard for data engineering delivery, mentors others as the capability grows, and partners closely with the Data & AI Consultant to ensure a clean bridge from advisory intent to delivered outcome. It is a build-and-deliver role at heart, with the seniority to define how the work is done well.

Job Description

Essential Functions

Client Delivery

  • Lead the hands-on delivery of data engineering across client engagements, including data pipelines, integrations, transformations, and the data foundations that support analytics and AI.
  • Take direction from the advisory team and the Data & AI Consultant, converting assessed needs and designed target states into working, production-grade solutions.
  • Own the technical quality of data engineering deliverables, ensuring they are reliable, maintainable, and fit for the client's real operating environment.
  • Work directly with client technical teams to deploy, integrate, and hand over solutions in a way the client can sustain.
  • Advise on the practical realities of data infrastructure, surfacing constraints and risks early so delivery plans stay grounded.

Internal & Client-Facing Frameworks

  • Build and maintain the reusable data engineering frameworks, patterns, and accelerators that let ARKANCE deliver consistently across clients.
  • Shape the internal data capability of the practice, including the tooling, pipelines, and data foundations behind ARKANCE's own accelerators, benchmarks, and delivery assets.
  • Develop client-facing delivery approaches - reference architectures, integration patterns, and standards - that raise the quality and repeatability of engagements.
  • Contribute to the practice's technical standards and definition of done for data engineering work.

Technical Leadership

  • Set and uphold the technical standard for data engineering delivery across the practice.
  • Mentor and develop other engineers as the delivery capability grows, sharing patterns and raising the bar on quality.
  • Partner with the Data & AI Consultant to ensure advisory intent translates cleanly into delivered outcomes, and feed delivery insight back into how the practice scopes and estimates.
  • Stay current with the data engineering landscape - platforms, tooling, and integration approaches - and bring proven practice into ARKANCE's delivery.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Perform all other duties as assigned.
  • Duties and responsibilities are subject to change based on business needs.

Decision-Making & Autonomy

Operates with significant autonomy in data engineering delivery, technical design, and the frameworks and standards that support it. Serves as the senior technical authority for data engineering across client delivery and internal capability, partnering with advisory and delivery leadership to ensure the work is delivered well and scales. Sets the technical standard others work to, and escalates commercial and engagement-shaping decisions to advisory and delivery leadership.

Qualifications

  • Substantial hands-on data engineering experience, including data pipelines, integrations, transformations, and production data infrastructure.
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver data engineering work in a client or customer-facing setting, translating requirements into reliable, maintainable solutions.
  • Experience building reusable frameworks, patterns, or standards that improve delivery quality and repeatability, not just one-off builds.
  • Strong grounding in data architecture, data quality, and governance, with the judgment to make sound trade-offs under real-world constraints.
  • Working understanding of how data foundations enable analytics and AI, and the ability to partner with advisory colleagues on data and AI initiatives.
  • Technical leadership experience, including setting standards and mentoring other engineers, with the seniority to define how the work is done well.
  • Familiarity with the AECO industry and the Autodesk ecosystem preferred, or the ability to build that context quickly.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

phData is expanding its advisory practice with a focus on building our business with Anthropic and guiding our Customers on building out their AI FinOps Strategy. We are looking for a Consulting Director to lead that growth. This is a senior, Customer-facing leadership role for someone who has advised executives on enterprise technology strategy before and wants to bring that experience to how organizations plan, govern, and pay for AI.

The ideal candidate splits their time three ways:

  • Trusted advisor in the room with Customer executives, their teams, and phData delivery resources
  • Builder of our Anthropic book of business and services
  • Public voice on how enterprises should think about the economics of AI, bringing a credible point of view on FinOps in AI to conversations that are often dominated by technical considerations alone

This role is accountable for turning our Advisory capabilities, that span Strategy, Governance, and Change, into sellable, repeatable offerings and for personally delivering the highest-value engagements.

What You'll Do

Executive Advisory & Delivery

Practice & Business Growth

  • Partner with sales and account teams on presales, shaping proposals, scoping advisory engagements, and participating directly in Customer pursuits

Marketing & Thought Leadership

  • Represent phData at industry events, webinars, and Anthropic-sponsored forums

Delivery Oversight

What You'll Bring

  • Demonstrated experience designing and facilitating strategy sessions

  • Experience with Anthropic's Claude platform, and the broader enterprise AI landscape
  • Business development experience, comfortable shaping deals, scoping SOWs, and participating in presales conversations

What Success Looks Like

Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Your Impact

The Justice Senior Customer Success Manager will work with Axon Justice’s largest Prosecutor and Public Defender customers to build long-term, strategic partnerships. You will work closely with your clients to understand their workflows, organizational structures and overall requirements. As their main point of contact, your customers will lean on you to provide best practices and to help them achieve their operational goals through the use of Axon’s products.

You will also work closely with multiple cross-functional teams by providing invaluable insight into customers’ needs and challenges, helping influence and guide internal product road-maps and projects.

As someone who operate in a cross-functional capacity with a particular focus on Justice workflows and stakeholders, from project management to product expert to consultant, you will continually be focused on making your customers more efficient and more confident within their daily workflows.

What You’ll Do

Location: Remote, West Coast
Reports to: Director, Customer Success
Travel: 30-35%

  • Engage with your customers through regular calls, business reviews and daily needs
  • Monitor and manage adoption metrics to ensure customers are utilizing the full Axon Justice platform
  • Create success plans for your customers and document customer progress toward established goals and results
  • Manage escalations closely, acting as the quarterback for all critical issues and ensuring multiple internal teams are aligned
  • Communicating major milestones and updates to Sr. Leadership on a regular basis
  • Work closely with Axon’s marketing and training teams to conduct regular training webinars and calls
  • Develop a deep understanding of Axon’s product lines and ensure proper implementation in every customer’s environment
  • Learn and share industry best practices in order to solve customer needs
  • Partner with Sales to identify growth and expansion opportunities within accounts

What You Bring

  • Required Experience: Justice / Legal Sector. We are seeking candidates with deep experience in the justice/legal sector, ideally within Prosecutor or Public Defender offices, with strong knowledge of discovery, digital evidence management, case management, motions and filings, courtroom processes, and interactions with law enforcement. Experience working with prosecutors, defense attorneys, or other legal practitioners is highly valued.
  • Proven Justice Stakeholder Engagement: The role requires proven ability to engage effectively with justice stakeholders (e.g. DAs, ADAs, PDs and IT). Candidates should be familiar with the constraints and priorities these stakeholders face (e.g. statutory deadlines, discovery disclosure, ethical obligations) and able to translate those into customer success strategies.
  • Strong project management skills with a proven system for tracking multiple customer requests, issues and strategic plans
  • A proven track record of leading process improvements within large organizations
  • Previous experience tracking product adoption and customer engagement through data-analysis tools
  • Self-motivated, team-oriented, responsible, and focused on exceeding customer expectations
  • Exceptional organizational, presentation, and communication skills, both verbal and written
  • Demonstrated ability to deal with change and excel in high-stress situations
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience

Benefits that Benefit You

  • Competitive salary and 401k with employer match
  • Discretionary paid time off
  • Paid parental leave for all
  • Medical, Dental, Vision plans
  • Fitness Programs
  • Emotional & Mental Wellness support
  • Learning & Development programs
  • Employee Resource Groups (ERGs)
  • And yes, we have snacks in our offices

Benefits listed herein may vary depending on the nature of your employment and the location where you work.

Axon is a total compensation company, meaning compensation is made up of base pay, bonus, and stock awards. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: level, function, training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs, geographic market, and often a combination of all these factors. Our benefits offer an array of options to help support you physically, financially and emotionally through the big milestones and in your everyday life. To see more details on our benefits offerings please visit .

Base Pay Range
$86,250—$138,000 USD

Don’t meet every single requirement? That's ok. At Axon, we Aim Far. We think big with a long-term view because we want to reinvent the world to be a safer, better place. We are also committed to building diverse teams that reflect the communities we serve.

Studies have shown that women and people of color are less likely to apply to jobs unless they check every box in the job description. If you’re excited about this role and our mission to Protect Life but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification listed here, we encourage you to apply anyways. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.

The company's solutions, products, and services are actively used by the top 100 Pharma and Life Science companies.
At Viseven, our rapidly growing team boasts over 700 highly skilled professionals, including experts in development, design, business analysis, project management, delivery, sales, marketing, and customer success.
With a global footprint in more than 30 countries across the US, LATAM, Europe, and APAC, and physical offices in Ukraine, Poland, Estonia, India, and the US, we are well-positioned to serve our diverse clientele.
Join us and become part of a pioneering team dedicated to shaping the future of digital transformation in Pharma and Life Sciences across more than 50 countries around the globe.

We are looking for a Middle Full Stack Developer to join our team and contribute to the development of AI-powered solutions.

In this role, you’ll work on well-defined tasks of moderate complexity, collaborating with experienced engineers and receiving guidance and code reviews. You’ll contribute to larger AI initiatives and help build reliable, scalable applications powered by modern Generative AI technologies.

Responsibilities:

    As a Middle Full stack Engineer, you'll work on well-scoped tasks of moderate complexity, with guidance and code review from senior engineers, contributing to larger AI initiatives owned by the team.
    - Develop and integrate AI agents with tool-use, memory, and context management, leveraging LangChain, LangGraph, and LangSmith frameworks, and integrating with foundational Large Language Models (LLMs).
    - Integrate LLMs with external tools, APIs, knowledge sources, and enterprise systems.
    - Contribute to building retrieval layers (e.g., hybrid search, vector search, metadata filtering) optimized for LLM consumption.
    - Stay up to date with modern technologies and best practices for building Gen AI-based applications.

Required skills & knowledge:

    - Proficiency in TypeScript and Node.js.

    - Good understanding of software design principles, design patterns, and modern development best practices.
    - Experience with NoSQL databases; familiarity with vector databases (OpenSearch a plus).
    - Familiarity with AI agent workflows (tool-use, memory, and context management), or a strong interest in building them.
    - Basic understanding of agentic behaviors and patterns, such as planning, retrieval, and self-correction.
    - Exposure to LangChain and/or LangGraph libraries (or a strong willingness to ramp up quickly).
    - Understanding of RAG workflows; hands-on experience is a plus.
    - Familiarity with evaluation and testing approaches for AI systems.

    Nice to have:

    - Experience working with a microservices-based architecture.
    - Experience with AWS (S3, Lambda, ECS, Bedrock).
    - Experience with Docker & Kubernetes.

    - Python knowledge.

What we provide:

Competitive Compensation: Regular performance-based salary and career development reviews.

Rôle et profil recherché

Relevant du Chef d’équipe, Recherche et Développement, l’Analyste d’affaires – Secteur immobilier jouera un rôle central dans la transformation de nos produits par l’intelligence artificielle. À l’intersection des clients, du produit et des équipes techniques, cette personne traduira les réalités immobilières en besoins, règles d’affaires, données et scénarios afin de créer des fonctionnalités et des agents IA fiables et créateurs de valeur.

Nous recherchons une personne qui comprend en profondeur le domaine immobilier et les défis de ses gestionnaires. Elle saura écouter les clients, modéliser leurs processus et guider les développeurs afin que les agents IA répondent aux besoins d’affaires, couvrent les cas limites et produisent des résultats explicables. Alors que l’IA accélère la production logicielle, ce rôle sera garant de la pertinence, de la cohérence et de la valeur des solutions livrées.

Responsabilités et fonctions :

  • Comprendre et traduire les besoins du marché immobilier : cerner avec les clients et les équipes internes les processus, irritants et priorités, puis les traduire en règles métier, exigences fonctionnelles, cas d’usage, scénarios, critères d’acceptation et cas limites clairs pour les développeurs.

  • Participer à la conception des agents IA : définir avec les équipes produit et techniques l’intention, le contexte, les données, les actions permises, les règles de décision, les contrôles humains et les résultats attendus.

  • Prioriser les occasions à forte valeur : repérer les processus immobiliers pouvant être améliorés, automatisés ou soutenus par l’IA, puis évaluer leur valeur client, leur faisabilité et leurs risques.

  • Contribuer à la validation avec les clients : tester les hypothèses, présenter au besoin des prototypes ou preuves de concept, recueillir la rétroaction et ajuster les solutions avant leur mise en production.

  • Assurer la fiabilité fonctionnelle : vérifier que les résultats de l’IA sont cohérents, explicables et conformes aux règles du domaine, puis collaborer avec l’assurance qualité aux tests et scénarios d’exception.

  • Soutenir la transformation IA et la feuille de route : utiliser l’IA pour accélérer l’analyse, la documentation et la validation avec jugement, traçabilité et responsabilité; contribuer à la modernisation de Hopem Immobilier et au développement d’agents IA spécialisés.

Exigences :

  • Expérience métier : expérience pertinente en analyse d’affaires, analyse fonctionnelle, gestion de produit ou amélioration de processus dans un environnement logiciel.

  • Connaissance du domaine immobilier : expérience concrète et bonne compréhension des réalités, processus et besoins de la gestion immobilière; un atout déterminant.

  • Innovation : curiosité et capacité à repérer des améliorations, à remettre en question les façons de faire et à contribuer à des solutions innovantes, notamment par l’IA.

  • Capacité d’analyse : aptitude à comprendre des processus complexes, à clarifier les règles d’affaires et à traduire les besoins clients en exigences précises.

  • Communication et vulgarisation : excellentes habiletés pour écouter, synthétiser et expliquer simplement des besoins d’affaires et des concepts complexes à des interlocuteurs clients, produit et techniques.

  • Autonomie et jugement : rigueur, sens pratique et capacité à faire progresser des besoins complexes ou peu définis.

  • Collaboration technique : capacité à établir un langage commun entre les réalités d’affaires et techniques et à collaborer efficacement avec les développeurs.

Les avantages offerts :

  • Un régime d’avantages sociaux complet comprenant les assurances médicale, dentaire et visuelle, un programme vie active de 325 $ par année, un programme d’aide aux employés, un REER collectif ainsi qu’un programme d’actionnariat des employés.

  • Trois semaines de vacances, cinq journées personnelles pour vous ressourcer ainsi qu’une journée de bénévolat dédiée à l’engagement communautaire.

  • Des modalités de travail flexibles favorisant la conciliation travail-vie personnelle, incluant le télétravail et un complément de prestations de maternité pour les six premières semaines.

  • De nombreuses possibilités de développement et d’avancement professionnel.

  • Une équipe collaborative composée de collègues passionnés, où l’entraide, le respect et l’esprit d’équipe sont au cœur du quotidien.

  • Et surtout, une ambiance de travail conviviale où les rires et le plaisir au travail font partie de la culture!

*Seul les candidats retenus seront contactés.

Harris souscrit à un programme d’accès à l’égalité en emploi et les candidatures des membres des groupes visés à savoir les femmes, les personnes handicapées, les personnes autochtones et les minorités visibles sont encouragées à soumettre leur candidature. Si vous êtes une personne handicapée, vous pouvez recevoir, sur demande, de l’assistance pour le processus de présélection et de sélection.

L'équipe de recrutement de talents de Harris n'a pas recours aux messages texte pour entrer en communication avec les candidats ou solliciter des informations confidentielles. Nous encourageons tous les candidats à postuler sur des postes publiés. The Customer Acquisition Specialist at The Hive Careers is responsible for developing and executing strategies to attract new clients, expand the company's customer base, and strengthen client relationships through proactive outreach. This role works closely with the marketing and sales teams to generate leads, optimize conversion funnels, support client outreach initiatives, and ensure a seamless onboarding experience for new customers.

Lead Generation: Identify and engage potential customers through various channels, including digital marketing, social media, email campaigns, networking events, and direct outreach.

Marketing Funnel Optimization: Analyze and improve the customer journey from awareness to conversion, ensuring efficient processes that maximize acquisition rates.

Data Analysis: Monitor and evaluate key performance indicators (KPIs) related to customer acquisition and outreach efforts, providing regular reports and insights to guide strategic decisions.

Collaboration: Work closely with the marketing and sales teams to align acquisition strategies with overall business objectives and maintain consistent messaging across all platforms.

Customer Onboarding: Oversee the onboarding process for new clients, ensuring a positive experience that supports long-term relationships.

Market Research: Stay informed about industry trends, competitor activities, and customer preferences to identify new growth opportunities.

Budget Management: Manage acquisition budgets effectively, ensuring resources are allocated strategically to meet targets.

  • Proven experience in customer acquisition, client outreach, sales, or marketing roles
  • At least 3-5 years experience in B2B client acquisition

AI SOLUTIONS ARCHITECT POST-SALES

Remote [within the US]- preferably West Coast

ABOUT THE ROLE:

We are seeking a motivated Solutions Architect Post-Sales to join our customer success team, specializing in the AI security space. As a post-sales Solutions Architect, you will be instrumental in ensuring the successful deployment, adoption, and ongoing value realization of our AI security solutions. You will work directly with customers after the sale to understand their environments, integrate our technology into their workflows, and help them iterate quickly to maximize security and performance outcomes.

Your ability to collaborate with customers, leverage modern technologies (cloud, containerization, networking), and translate feedback into actionable improvements will make you a trusted advisor and a key contributor to our long-term customer relationships.

WHO WE ARE:

HiddenLayer protects the world’s most valuable technologies from adversarial AI attacks. We were founded by AI professionals and security specialists with first-hand experience of how insidious adversarial AI attacks can be to detect and defend against. Determined to prove that these attacks were preventable, the team developed a unique, patent-pending, productized solution to support organizations in accelerating their adoption of AI securely.

Our dedication to innovation has been recognized by prestigious awards such as RSA's Innovation Sandbox Winner, CB Insights AI 100, CyberTech 100, and SC's Most Promising Early-Stage Start-up.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Customer Onboarding & Deployment: Partner with customers to design and implement secure deployments of our AI security solutions, ensuring seamless integration into their environments (cloud, on-prem, or hybrid).
  • Technical Guidance & Iteration: Provide expert technical consultation on infrastructure, containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and cloud networking. Help customers rapidly iterate and adopt best practices for secure AI operations.
  • Customer Success Ownership: Act as the primary technical point of contact post-sale, ensuring customers derive ongoing value, achieve their security objectives, and successfully scale their deployments.
  • Troubleshooting & Optimization: Diagnose and resolve customer issues, optimize configurations, and proactively identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Enablement & Training: Deliver hands-on workshops, training sessions, and technical documentation to empower customer teams to be self-sufficient with our products.
  • Feedback Loop: Capture customer feedback and collaborate with product management, engineering, and research teams to inform roadmap priorities and product enhancements.

WHO YOU ARE:

  • Proven experience in a post-sales, customer success, or solutions engineering role (AI, security, or cloud-based products preferred).
  • Strong experience with Docker and containerized workloads; familiarity with Kubernetes is highly desirable.
  • Hands-on cloud experience (AWS, Azure, or GCP), including cloud networking concepts and Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
  • Python programming experience required; familiarity with AI/ML workflows (LangChain, LangGraph, MLOps tools) is a plus.
  • Skilled at troubleshooting technical issues and guiding customers through iterative solution design.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills; comfortable working with both technical and business stakeholders.
  • Self-motivated, adaptable, and passionate about helping customers succeed.

WHY HIDDENLAYER?

We just raised $100M in Series B funding led by Delta-v Capital, with backing from Morgan Stanley, Microsoft's venture arm, Booz Allen Hamilton, and others. It's a validation of what we've built: 10x revenue growth, 50+ new enterprise customers, and deployments across defense, finance, and the world's largest AI platforms. This funding goes straight into expanding our platform and GTM capabilities, and into growing our team globally.

Attracting and retaining the very best people is our #1 priority. That’s why we offer our team best-in-class benefits, including:

  • Fully Remote: We are a completely remote global team. Though we’re distributed, we are intentional about getting the team together a couple of times a year. We offer a generous stipend for your home office setup, annual upgrades to ensure you have a comfortable workspace and a monthly stipend for internet/phone expenses.
  • Comprehensive Health & Wellness Benefits: Better than your average startup healthcare benefits. With five options to choose from, of which are fully subsidized by HiddenLayer, we offer a variety of options to fit each person’s needs. We also offer vision, dental, and 401k offerings.
  • Flexible Time Off: Enjoy unlimited and flexible time off for all salaried employees, in addition to 15 paid company holidays.
  • Commitment to Learning and Development: We support personal growth and education through a dedicated L&D fund that can be used for training, conferences, certifications and industry events.
  • Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion: We are committed to building a diverse team with individuals from various backgrounds, experiences, abilities, and perspectives, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

To learn more about HiddenLayer visitHiddenLayer and follow us on LinkedIn or Twitter.

HiddenLayer is an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, color, religion, national origin, age, marital status, political affiliation, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, disability or protected veteran status. We are committed to providing a workplace free of any discrimination or harassment.

Description

Keeper Security is hiring an experienced Senior Software Engineer to join our Vault team. In this role, you will help design and build modern, high-performance web and Electron-based desktop applications that secure data for millions of users worldwide. This is a 100% remote position, with an opportunity to work a hybrid schedule for candidates based in the El Dorado Hills, CA area.

Keeper’s cybersecurity software is trusted by millions of people and thousands of organizations globally. Keeper is published in 23 languages and sold in over 150 countries. Join one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity companies and play a key role in evolving one of our core products.

About Keeper

Keeper Security is one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity software companies that protects thousands of organizations and millions of people in over 150 countries. Keeper is a pioneer of zero-knowledge and zero-trust security built for any IT environment. Its core offering, KeeperPAM®, is an AI-enabled, cloud-native platform that protects all users, devices and infrastructure from cyber attacks. Recognized for its innovation in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Privileged Access Management (PAM), Keeper secures passwords and passkeys, infrastructure secrets, remote connections and endpoints with role-based enforcement policies, least privilege and just-in-time access. Learn why Keeper is trusted by leading organizations to defend against modern adversaries at KeeperSecurity.com.

About the Job

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Vault team, you will architect and deliver features across Keeper’s Web Vault. You will collaborate closely with Product, UX, Backend, QA and Security teams to ensure Vault remains secure, performant and intuitive. This is primarily a web application engineering role with a strong focus on React, TypeScript and modern frontend architecture. Experience with Electron, C++ or native desktop integrations is helpful but not required.

Responsibilities

  • Architect and implement modern, scalable web interfaces using React, Redux and TypeScript
  • Design and deliver features across Keeper’s Web Vault
  • Integrate with RESTful APIs while adhering to Keeper’s zero-knowledge and zero-trust security principles
  • Optimize application performance, including rendering efficiency, bundle size, memory usage and responsiveness
  • Collaborate with UX, Product, Backend, QA and Security teams to deliver secure, high-quality user experiences
  • Lead code reviews, promote engineering best practices and mentor less experienced engineers
  • Participate in CI/CD, automated testing and release processes to improve product quality and reliability
  • Troubleshoot complex frontend, browser and integration issues across supported environments
  • Use AI-assisted development tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot or similar platforms to improve coding, debugging, testing, technical research and documentation

Requirements

  • 7+ years of professional software engineering experience with a strong focus on frontend or web application development
  • Strong expertise in React, Redux and JavaScript/TypeScript
  • Strong understanding of modern frontend architecture, state management and component design
  • Experience building and maintaining complex web applications
  • Deep understanding of performance optimization, accessibility and cross-browser compatibility
  • Experience integrating frontend applications with RESTful APIs and backend services
  • Experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines and automated testing frameworks
  • Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills across modern web environments
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills
  • Ability and willingness to use AI-assisted tools effectively to improve software development, debugging, testing and technical documentation
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
  • Due to this role’s involvement in GovCloud environments, qualified candidates must be a U.S. Person, defined as a U.S. citizen or lawful permanent resident

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building security, identity, password management or other security-sensitive web applications
  • Experience with Electron-based desktop applications
  • Familiarity with C++ and/or Objective-C for native integrations
  • Experience with Node-API/N-API or similar native integration technologies
  • Familiarity with zero-knowledge, zero-trust or encryption-focused application architectures
  • Experience with accessibility standards and secure client-side development practices

Benefits

  • Medical, Dental & Vision (inclusive of domestic partnerships)
  • Employer Paid Life Insurance & Employee/Spouse/Child Supplemental life
  • Voluntary Short/Long Term Disability Insurance
  • 401K (Roth/Traditional)
  • A generous PTO plan that celebrates your commitment and seniority (including paid Bereavement/Jury Duty, etc)
  • Above market annual bonuses

Keeper Security, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and participant in the U.S. Federal E-Verify program. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Classification: Exempt

Keeper Candidate Privacy Notice

This notice explains how Keeper Security processes your personal data during recruitment. Depending on the role and location, the Controller of personal data (the organization responsible for determining why and how personal data is processed) will be Keeper Security Inc. (US), Keeper Security EMEA Ltd. (Ireland), or Keeper Security APAC K.K (Japan).

1. Data We Collect

Information You provide:

  • Contact details, CV/resume, cover letter
  • Employment history, qualifications, work eligibility
  • Application responses and uploaded documents

Information We generate:

  • Interview notes, assessments, communications
  • Scheduling information

Information From Others:

  • Recruiter/referral information who submit your profile
  • References (with your consent, before final offer)
  • Public professional profiles
  • Background verification (post offer)

Voluntary Diversity and Equal Opportunity Information

  • We may ask you to voluntarily provide diversity information including race/ethnicity, gender, disability status and veteran status (US). Providing this information is optional and Keeper collects this data in order to comply with EEOC and similar requirements

2. How We Use Your Data

  • Assess your application and suitability
  • Manage interviews and recruitment workflow
  • Consider you for other/future roles (we may seek your consent to keep your information on our systems beyond the retention period specified)
  • Comply with employment law obligations

3. Legal Basis

  • Legitimate Interests (recruitment management, security and integrity of the hiring process)
  • Contracting steps (for progressed candidates)
  • Legal and regulatory compliance obligations; explicit consent where required

4. Who We Share Information With

Internal:

  • HR, hiring managers, interviewers*, IT support for system administration

*Note - diversity and equal opportunity data is not shared with hiring managers.

Third Parties:

Service providers who assist with:

  • Applicant tracking, recruitment systems and assessment providers
  • Background verification vendors (post offer)
  • Recruitment agencies (where applicable)
  • Tools to support communication, collaboration and to securely store your data

Keeper ensures that all our third parties are contractually bound to protect your personal data with adequate safeguards in place.

5. International Transfers

Your data may be accessed by Keeper entities globally as needed for the purposes of hiring and decision making. We protect any such data transfer between Keeper entities using appropriate safeguards under applicable data protection laws.

6. Security

We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data, consistent with our industry leading security standards.

7. Retention

We keep your data for 24 months from your last application activity, then delete or anonymize it.

Exceptions:

  • You opt into our talent database for further retention by providing consent (extended retention)
  • You're hired (transfers to employee records)

8. Your Rights

You have the following rights and can contact us at the email below to exercise them:

  • Access, correct, or delete your data, subject to applicable law and retention requirements
  • Object to or restrict processing
  • Withdraw consent (where applicable)
  • Request data portability
  • Lodge a complaint with your data protection authority

If you become an employee, your rights regarding your employee record are governed by our internal Employee Privacy Notice and certain data will be retained as required under relevant laws such as employment or tax law.

When you request access to your personal data, some information may be redacted if it includes the personal data of other individuals or information that we must protect in order to preserve their privacy rights.

9. Automated Decisions

Keeper does not make hiring decisions using solely automated processing.
