raw.description:
★ PLEASE SUBMIT YOUR CV IN ENGLISH ★

Art Director – Performance Creative & AI

Work Arrangement: This is a fully remote (telecommute) position.
Employment Type: Full-Time
Department: Creative Post-Production
Reports To: Creative Director
Direct Report: Senior Editor/Designer
Industry: Digital Marketing / Performance Creative
Experience: 5–8+ Years
Portfolio: Required

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Art Director to lead concept development and own the visual standard across paid and organic campaigns.

This role sits at the intersection of creative strategy, performance marketing, and execution. You will define creative direction and ensure that the work produced delivers against that vision, from initial concept through final client-ready assets.

You will directly manage a Senior Editor/Designer, assign and prioritize work, review deliverables, provide actionable art direction, and maintain a consistently high creative standard.

Because the team works extensively with both traditional production and AI-generated creative (AIGC), you must have enough hands-on AI fluency to confidently direct generative work, evaluate output quality, identify artifacts or brand inconsistencies, and determine when AI or traditional production is the better approach.

You will collaborate closely with Client Partners and Media Strategists to translate performance insights into high-quality, scalable creative across Meta, TikTok, and YouTube.

What You'll Do

Creative Direction & Team Leadership

  • Directly manage and develop a Senior Editor/Designer, setting priorities and managing capacity across accounts.

  • Review video, motion, static, and AI-generated creative before it advances to the Creative Director or client.

  • Provide clear, actionable art direction across composition, typography, layout, pacing, color, motion, and brand consistency.

  • Identify whether creative challenges originate from craft, concept, or the brief and address them at the appropriate level.

  • Maintain a high creative standard without becoming a production bottleneck.

Concept Development & AI Creative

  • Lead the development of creative concepts, campaign ideas, and visual narratives across multiple client accounts.

  • Translate briefs, brand guidelines, and performance insights into clear creative direction.

  • Develop concept decks, storyboards, briefs, visual references, and prototypes, primarily using Figma.

  • Use AI tools to develop visual references, storyboards, creative examples, scripts, and ad copy aligned with each client's brand.

  • Direct AI-generated work by evaluating generation quality, identifying artifacts and off-brand outputs, and improving prompt and reference strategies.

  • Stay hands-on when necessary by sketching, mocking, or prototyping creative directions.

Creative Production & Workflow

  • Own the creative process from brief through final build and delivery.

  • Guide production and revision rounds while balancing creative quality with efficient iteration.

  • Review both internally produced and creator-generated content.

  • Oversee final assets across static, video, and motion formats, ensuring they are complete, properly versioned, and platform-ready.

  • Improve briefing, feedback, documentation, and AI production workflows to reduce unnecessary revision cycles.

Performance Creative & Strategy

  • Partner with Client Partners and Media teams to turn campaign performance insights into creative direction.

  • Apply learnings from high-performing hooks, formats, visual systems, and concepts to future campaigns.

  • Make recommendations on whether creative directions should be scaled, iterated, or discontinued based on performance.

  • Build creative post-mortems to understand why concepts succeeded or underperformed.

  • Understand how creative should evolve across different stages of the marketing funnel.

Creative Systems & Scalability

  • Develop repeatable creative frameworks, templates, and design systems.

  • Create reusable art-direction standards that allow quality to scale across the team.

  • Maintain visual consistency across formats, campaigns, and channels.

  • Contribute to AI production workflows, prompt/reference libraries, and scalable creative processes.

  • Stay current on platform trends, emerging formats, visual styles, and generative creative tools.

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • 5–8+ years of experience in Art Direction, Visual Design, or Performance Creative within an agency or brand environment.

  • Experience managing, mentoring, or formally directing at least one creative professional, such as a designer, editor, or motion artist.

  • Strong portfolio demonstrating concept development and visual direction across paid and digital channels.

  • Proven ability to translate strategy and performance insights into compelling, executable creative concepts.

  • Experience with social-first and performance-driven creative across Meta, TikTok, and YouTube.

  • Working fluency with AI creative tools such as Gemini/Nano Banana, Sora, Veo 3, Higgsfield, Seedance 2.0, or similar platforms.

  • Ability to evaluate and provide structured creative direction across video, motion, static, and AI-generated content.

  • Proficiency in Figma and Adobe Creative Suite.

  • Ability to manage multiple clients, campaigns, and priorities simultaneously.

  • Strong collaboration skills across creative, strategy, account, and media teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Background in performance marketing or direct-response creative.

  • Familiarity with UGC, creator-led, and platform-native advertising.

  • Working knowledge of After Effects and/or Premiere sufficient to effectively review post-production work.

  • Experience creating scalable creative systems, templates, or briefing frameworks.

  • Experience working with offshore teams or external creative partners.

  • Understanding of creative testing frameworks and iterative production workflows.

  • Experience establishing quality standards for AI-generated creative.

Ideal Candidate

You are a strong conceptual thinker who can transform strategy into creative ideas that are both visually compelling and realistically executable.

You know how to give specific, prioritized feedback that improves the work, and you genuinely enjoy developing other creatives.

You understand how to balance brand quality, performance, speed, and scalability, and you're comfortable leading the creative process while remaining hands-on when needed.

Most importantly, you have the judgment to distinguish between average and exceptional creative, including when that work is AI-generated.

How Success Is Measured

Success in this role will be reflected in:

  • Consistently high-quality creative across client accounts.

  • Strong alignment between creative direction and campaign performance.

  • Effective leadership and development of the creative team.

  • Efficient production and revision cycles.

  • Successful translation of performance insights into new creative concepts.

  • Scalable creative systems that maintain quality as production grows.

  • Effective integration of AI into creative workflows without compromising brand standards.

Why Join Us?

  • Own creative direction across a diverse portfolio of performance-driven campaigns.

  • Work at the intersection of creative strategy, performance marketing, and generative AI.

  • Direct both traditional and AI-powered creative production.

  • Influence creative systems, workflows, and quality standards.

  • Collaborate closely with experienced creative, strategy, account, and media professionals.

  • Help shape how AI is integrated into modern performance creative production.

Important Notes

  • A strong creative portfolio is required.

  • This is a senior, hands-on Art Direction role with direct responsibility for creative quality.

  • Candidates must have previous experience directing or managing another creative professional.

  • Candidates should be comfortable reviewing static, video, motion, and AI-generated creative.

  • Practical familiarity with modern generative AI tools is required; theoretical knowledge alone is not sufficient.

This is a fully remote (telecommute) position.

WORKFORCE POLICY SPECIALIST

Job Location:

Division of Employment and Rehabilitation Services (DERS)
Policy Administration
1789 West Jefferson Street, Phoenix, Arizona 85007

This position is available for remote work on a full-time basis within Arizona (including virtual office arrangement)

Posting Details:

Salary: $27.1410/ hourly ($56,453.28 annually)

Grade: 20

Closing Date: Open until sufficient resumes are received

Job Summary:

Would you like to be part of an amazing team that helps Arizonans thrive? At the Department of Economic Security (DES), we strengthen individuals, families, and communities for a better quality of life. DES is looking for individuals that are committed to service, community, and teamwork. To learn more about DES, please visit ; or click on the link here to view ‘Our DES’ video. Come join the DES Team!

The Department of Economic Security, Division of Employment and Rehabilitation Services (DERS) strengthens Arizona communities by bridging and minimizing gaps to employment and independence.

DES is seeking an experienced and highly motivated individual to join our team as a Workforce Policy Specialist with the Policy Administration. This position is responsible for developing and maintaining comprehensive policy manuals and user guides for program staff; responsible for implementing the various employment and training programs; reviewing proposed legislation and completing analysis for impact on the programs; writing detailed reports, issue papers, and correspondence; developing or assisting in the development of various state plans for federal approval;
developing programmatic forms, pamphlets, and brochures; providing technical assistance to internal and external customers; researching federal initiatives and national research for policy review and comparison; and assisting with the design of evaluation tools and programmatic training curriculum.

The State of Arizona strives for a work culture that aﬀords employees ﬂexibility, autonomy, and trust. Across our many agencies, boards, commissions, many State employees participate in the State’s Remote Work Program and are able to work remotely in their homes, in oﬃces, and in hoteling spaces. All work, including remote work, should be performed within Arizona, unless an exception is properly authorized in advance.

Job Duties:

Essential Duties and Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

• Analyze and interpret federal and state laws governing various Workforce programs; develop and maintain comprehensive policy and user guides for program staff; or assist in the development of various state plans for federal approval.
• Provide technical assistance, policy interpretation, and guidance (including final determinations regarding Quality Assurance monitoring case review items) to program staff, training staff, and other stakeholders, both public and private.
• Develop, redesign, and revise programmatic forms, pamphlets, and brochures.
• Review federal and state legislation, completing analysis for impact on the programs, and provide recommendations.
• Participate and contribute to special projects that may require learning and developing new program policies and procedures based on legislative or political changes.
• Participate in meetings, work groups, committees, and conferences related to the various programs within Employment Services.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities (KSAs):

Knowledge in:

  • State and federal laws, regulations, and policies and procedures governing DERS programs, in particular, Temporary Assistance for Needy Families (TANF) Jobs Program, TANF Refugee Program, and the Senior Community Service Employment Program (SCSEP).
    • Federal and State legislative and rulemaking processes.
    • Departmental rules, regulations, policies, and procedures.
    • Principles of policy formulation, analysis, and evaluation.

Skill in:

  • Written and oral communication to convey a wide variety of information.
    • Problem-solving, research, and analytical skills.
    • Gathering, organizing, and summarizing information and data from varied sources, creating and maintaining comprehensive reports.
    • Interpersonal/relationship, time management, organizational, and planning.

    Ability to:
    • Manage multiple time-sensitive, complex projects effectively and with attention to detail.
    • Provide clear and effective guidance and direction regarding policies and procedures.
    • Critically analyze program activities and develop effective plans and methods for program improvement.
    • Effectively use a personal computer and related software for communication, word processing, spreadsheet creation and maintenance, and project management.
Selective Preference(s):

The ideal candidate for this position will have:

• Three (3) years of programmatic work experience in the field of TANF Jobs, or TANF Refugee.
• SCSEP or in any of the programs administered by the Division of Employment & Rehabilitation Services (DERS).

Pre-Employment Requirements:
  • Successfully pass background and reference checks; employment is contingent upon completion of the above-mentioned process and the agency’s ability to reasonably accommodate any restrictions.
    • All newly hired State employees are subject to and must successfully complete the Electronic Employment Eligibility Verification Program (E-Verify).
    • Travel will be required for State business. Any employee operating a motor vehicle on State business must possess and retain a current, valid class-appropriate driver’s license, complete all required training, and successfully pass all necessary driver’s license record checks. The license must be current, unexpired, and neither revoked nor suspended. Employees who drive on State business are subject to driver’s license record checks, must maintain acceptable driving records, and must complete all required driver training. An employee who operates a personally owned vehicle on State business shall maintain the statutorily required liability insurance (see Arizona Administrative Code [A.A.C.] R2-10-207.11).
Benefits:

The Arizona Department of Economic Security offers a comprehensive benefits package to include:

• Affordable medical, dental, life, and short-term disability insurance plans
• Participation in the Arizona State Retirement System (ASRS) and long-term disability plans

• 10 paid holidays per year

• Paid vacation and sick time

  • Paid Parental Leave-Up to 12 weeks per year paid leave for newborn or newly-placed foster/adopted child.
    • Deferred compensation plan
    • Wellness plans
    • Tuition Reimbursement
    • Stipend Opportunities
    • Infant at Work Program
    • Rideshare and Public Transit Subsidy
    • Career Advancement & Employee Development Opportunities

By providing the option of a full-time or part-time remote work schedule, employees enjoy improved work/life balance, report higher job satisfaction, and are more productive. Remote work is a management option and not an employee entitlement or right. An agency may terminate a remote work agreement at its discretion.

Learn more about the Paid Parental Leave program here. For a complete list of benefits provided by The State of Arizona, please visit our benefits page

Retirement:

State employees are required to participate in the Arizona State Retirement System (ASRS), the State sponsored retirement contribution plan and the Long-Term Disability (LTD) program after a 27-week waiting period. The ASRS defined benefit plan provides for life-long income upon retirement. You will also have the option to participate in a voluntary deferred compensation program to take advantage of tax-deferred retirement investments.

On, or shortly after, your first day of work you will be provided with additional information about the available insurance plans, enrollment instructions, submission deadlines and effective dates.

Contact Us:

For questions about this career opportunity, please contact Liz Alarcon at (480) 521-0391 or email .

Over 9,000 companies — from scrappy startups to global brands — use our platform to send billions of emails, push notifications, in-app messages, and SMS every day. Customer.io powers automated communication that people actually want to receive. We help teams send smarter, more relevant messages using real-time behavioral data.

About the role

Hi, my name is Eric Anderson, Senior Controller at Customer.io, and I'm looking for an AP Contractor to keep our T&E engine running clean through a busy stretch. Our Accounting team relies on Ramp and Navan to keep expense and travel spend moving, and we need someone who can own the day-to-day grind — coding, reconciling, chasing exceptions — without losing sight of the bigger picture. This is a 6-month contract with real ownership from day one, working closely with Terre Holmes and the AP team.

What we value

  • Ownership — you drive the exception queue to zero, not someone else.
  • Directness — you enforce policy clearly and kindly, without dodging hard conversations.
  • Precision — a mismatched dollar amount doesn't get past you.

What you’ll do

  • Own Ramp expense management end-to-end — review, code, and approve expense reports, chase missing receipts, and enforce policy compliance.
  • Administer Navan travel — reconcile bookings and spend, flag policy exceptions, and support employees through out-of-policy approvals.
  • Review AP bills for accuracy, coding, and approval routing — catching duplicate invoices and mismatched amounts before they hit the payment queue.
  • Reconcile Ramp and Navan activity against the GL and drive the exception queue to zero before every close.
  • Serve as the responsive point of contact for vendors — confirming payment details, tracking status, and resolving disputes.
  • Spot recurring T&E headaches and propose (and document) process fixes.

What we're looking for

  • 3+ years of AP & T&E experience, ideally in SaaS or a high-growth environment
  • Hands-on experience with Ramp and/or Navan (or comparable — Concur, Expensify, TravelPerk)
  • Sharp eye for detail and a solid grasp of expense policy enforcement
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to manage a recurring, deadline-driven workload
  • Experience with NetSuite or a comparable ERP is a plus

Compensation & Benefits

This is a contracted engagement at $45–60/hr USD, depending on experience, for an estimated 6-month term.

Our Process

No gotchas, no trick questions - just a clear, human process designed to help both of us make an informed decision.

  1. 30-minute video call with a Recruiter
  2. 45-minute video call with the Hiring Manager
  3. 45-minute cross-functional screen with a member of the AP team

All final candidates will be asked to complete a background check and employment verifications as part of our pre-employment process.

Customer.io recognizes the stifling impact of systemic injustice on diverse communities. We commit to using our influence to increase inclusion and equity within the tech industry. We strive to build an inclusive team culture, implement bias-free hiring practices, and develop community partnerships to expand our global impact.

Zoom is the only video conference platform that we use, virtual interviews will be conducted using the video capability (i.e., not via the chat), and offers will be extended in writing on official Customer.io letterhead. Please be vigilant in all of your job search activity, and if you have any questions please contact .

Join us!

Check out our careers page for more information about why you should come work with us! We believe in empathy, transparency, responsibility, and, yes, a little awkwardness. If you’re excited by what you read — apply now.

raw.description:
The IT Project Manager is responsible for leading the delivery of Infrastructure Security projects within a global pharmaceutical environment, with primary focus on OT Security platforms and Secure File Transfer solutions. The role oversees the implementation, enhancement, and rollout of technologies that strengthen operational technology cybersecurity, secure data exchange, threat prevention, and regulatory compliance. Working across Infrastructure, Security, OT, and business teams, the Project Manager ensures successful delivery of these security platforms while maintaining alignment with enterprise architecture, cybersecurity strategy, and business objectives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end delivery of infrastructure security projects, with a primary focus on OT Security platforms (e.g., Claroty) and Secure File Transfer/File Security solutions.
  • Manage implementation and expansion of OT cybersecurity capabilities, including asset visibility, threat detection, risk management, and OT network security.
  • Lead deployment of secure file transfer and file security platforms, ensuring secure data exchange, malware scanning, threat prevention, and compliance with security standards.
  • Coordinate activities across OT, Infrastructure, Network, Security Operations, and site teams to ensure successful technology deployment.
  • Manage project plans, budgets, risks, dependencies, vendors, and delivery milestones.
  • Ensure alignment of platform implementations with enterprise security architecture, operational requirements, and compliance expectations.
  • Prepare and present project status, risks, and key decisions to steering committees and senior stakeholders.
  • Drive governance, testing, validation, and production readiness activities throughout the project lifecycle.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience managing enterprise infrastructure and cybersecurity projects.
  • Proven experience delivering security platform implementations, infrastructure modernization, or cybersecurity transformation initiatives.
  • Good understanding of OT Security, industrial cybersecurity, and IT/OT environments.
  • Experience with Secure File Transfer, file security, content security, or threat prevention solutions.
  • Experience in pharmaceutical, life sciences, manufacturing, or critical infrastructure environments (GxP.
  • Strong experience managing technical vendors, global stakeholders, and multi-site deployments.
  • Solid knowledge of Waterfall, Hybrid, and structured project governance methodologies.
  • Strong stakeholder management, communication, risk management, and budget control skills.
  • Fluent English with experience working in global and regulated environments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with Claroty, OPSWAT, or comparable OT security and file security platforms.
  • Knowledge of network segmentation, SIEM, PAM, secure remote access, or industrial network architectures.
  • PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent project management certification.

WHY YOU SHOULD JOIN FUSION:

At Fusion, you’ll join a diverse team of talented professionals from around the world, united by a passion for delivering impactful digital transformation in the life sciences industry. You’ll be part of a flat-structured, collaborative organization where decisions are made efficiently, and your expertise directly shapes client outcomes.

You’ll work alongside experienced consultants on complex, meaningful projects that demand both precision and innovation. Our culture emphasizes continuous learning, open knowledge sharing, and cross-functional teamwork—empowering you to grow both professionally and personally.

Joining Fusion means becoming part of a company that:

  • Builds strong, trusted partnerships with clients, delivering tailored solutions that create real business value.
  • Drives delivery excellence, holding ourselves accountable for the quality and impact of every outcome.
  • Encourages entrepreneurial thinking, empowering you to take initiative, solve problems, and lead change.
  • Operates with a truly global mindset, where diverse perspectives, cultures, and collaboration fuel our success.

WHAT WE OFFER - FUSION BENEFITS

We’ve designed our benefits to support your growth, well-being, and global mobility.

Growth & Development

  • Invest in Your Learning: Access annual budget for professional development.
  • Grow Your Skills: Join regular workshops and trainings to strengthen technical and soft skills.
  • Advance Continuously: Build the mindset, confidence, and capabilities to grow your career on your terms.
  • Shape an Inclusive Culture: Thrive in a workplace where your individuality is valued, and your voice drives meaningful change.

Recognition & Reward

  • Earn What You’re Worth: Receive a competitive salary and benefits package that reflects your impact.
  • Refer Talent: Get rewarded for recommending new hires through our referral program.
  • Stay Rewarded: Access loyalty-based benefits starting from your third year via the Unity Scheme.

Global Mobility & Local Support

  • Navigate Global Moves: Get help with visas, permits, and international assignments.
  • Benefit Locally: Enjoy perks tailored to your country of residence.
  • Collaborate Globally: Work in a diverse, inclusive culture where global teamwork drives success

Transforming Life Science Consulting Worldwide.

Fusion Consulting is a globally leading Business and IT boutique consultancy specialized in the Life Sciences industry, partnering with leading companies in pharma, healthcare, and animal health.

With over 450 employees and 25 offices worldwide, our mission is to revolutionize our clients' business transformation challenges and set new industry standards through innovative solutions.

Focused on S/4HANA, Data & Cloud, and innovative technologies, Fusion Consulting brings unparalleled expertise and commitment to excellence to every project we undertake.

Grounded in our commitment to fast and intelligent decision-making, our client-first and open-hearted approach defines our ethos. With unwavering support and an entrepreneurial spirit, our global teamwork transcends boundaries and turns shared visions into reality.

At Fusion, we unite entrepreneurial minds from around the globe to develop and implement game-changing solutions that build lasting relationships with our clients.

raw.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE:

Our pharmacy benefit management (PBM) offering represents an important growth area for Rightway. Helping clients better manage pharmacy spend to make drugs more affordable for their employees and dependents is critical to their business sustainability. Rightway is responsible for designing, building, and operating a new-to-the-world PBM model base on our core tenets: fairness & transparency, unlocking the supply chain, supporting the physician-patient relationship, and utilizing navigation to empower consumers.

The PBM Operations Associate is a member of the Rightway Operations team reporting to the Manager, Benefit Configuration. This role will be responsible for the configuration and maintenance of benefits, and related claims adjudication rules within the claim platforms.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Review client benefit design documentation for completeness and accuracy, flagging open items and partnering with implementation and client success to resolve gaps prior to configuration.
  • Configure client benefit designs in the claims adjudication platform, including plan parameters, copay structures, inclusions and exclusions, and utilization management edits, for both new client implementations and mid-year plan changes.
  • Develop and execute test claim scenarios to validate benefit setup prior to go-live, and perform ongoing monitoring and regression testing to confirm accuracy after changes. Research, document, and correct identified defects through to resolution.
  • Research and resolve inquiries related to claims adjudication and benefit configuration, partnering with client success to communicate findings and remediation steps.
  • Work cross-functionally with product, client success, implementation, and formulary teams to ensure benefits are built and operating according to signed client requirements.
  • Maintain complete, audit-ready documentation of benefit setup, testing evidence, and internal controls in support of audit and internal quality standards.
  • Track work across implementation and plan change trackers, keeping status, ownership, and deadlines current so cross-functional partners have real-time visibility.

WHO YOU ARE:

  • Bachelor’s degree preferred; relevant experience considered for exceptional candidates.
  • 1-3 years of PBM experience in claims adjudication, benefit configuration, or testing/QA.
  • Pharmacy Technician certification or related pharmacy experience highly desirable.
  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to trace a claim outcome back to its configuration driver.
  • Comfortable navigating ambiguity; able to work from incomplete requirements, ask the right questions, and exercise sound judgment when documentation doesn’t cover every scenario.
  • Comfortable working in structured tools (Excel, Smartsheet, claims platforms) and managing multiple client deliverables against firm deadlines.
  • Clear written communicator who documents decisions and keeps stakeholders informed without being prompted.

COMPENSATION: $65,000 - $85,000annually, in addition to bonus and equity.

Compensation offered will be determined by geographic location, experience, and qualifications.

CYBERSECURITY AWARENESS NOTICE

In response to ongoing and industry-wide fraudulent recruitment activities (i.e., job scams), Rightway wants to inform potential candidates that we will only contact them from the @ email domain. We will never ask for bank details or deposits of any kind as a condition of employment.

ABOUT RIGHTWAY:

Rightway is on a mission to harmonize healthcare for everyone, everywhere. Our products guide patients to the best care and medications by inserting clinicians and pharmacists into a patient’s care journey through a modern, mobile app. Rightway is a front door to healthcare, giving patients the tools they need along with on-demand access to Rightway health guides, human experts that answer their questions and manage the frustrating parts of healthcare for them.

Since its founding in 2017, Rightway has raised over $200mm from investors including Khosla Ventures, Thrive Capital, and Tiger Global. We’re headquartered in New York City, with satellite offices in Denver and Dallas. Our clients rely on us to transform the healthcare experience, improve outcomes for their teams, and decrease their healthcare costs.

HOW WE LIVE OUR VALUES TO OUR TEAMMATES:

We’re seeking those with passion for healthcare and relentless devotion to our goal. We need team members that embody our core values:

1) We are human, firstOur humanity binds us together. We bring the same empathetic approach to every individual we engage with, whether it be our members, our clients, or each other. We are all worthy of respect and understanding and we engage in our interactions with care and intention. We honor our stories. We listen to—and hear—each other, we celebrate our differences and similarities, we are present for each other, and we strive for mutual understanding.

2) We redefine what is possibleWe always look beyond the obstacles in front of us to imagine new solutions. We approach our work with inspiration from other industries, other leaders, and other challenges. We use ingenuity and resourcefulness when faced with tough problems.

3) We debate then commitWe believe that a spirit of open discourse is part of a healthy culture. We understand and appreciate different perspectives and we challenge our assumptions. When working toward a decision or a new solution, we actively listen to one another, approach it with a “yes, and” mentality, and assume positive intent. Once a decision is made, we align and champion it as one team.

4) We cultivate gritChanging healthcare doesn’t happen overnight. We reflect and learn from challenges and approach the future with a determination to strive for better. In the face of daunting situations, we value persistence. We embrace failure as a stepping stone to future success. On this journey, we seek to act with guts, resilience, initiative, and tenacity.

5) We seek to delightHealthcare is complicated and personal. We work tirelessly to meet the goals of our clients while also delivering the best experience to our members. We recognize that no matter the role or team, we each play a crucial part in our members’ care and take that responsibility seriously. When faced with an obstacle, we are kind, respectful, and solution-oriented in our approach. We hold ourselves accountable to our clients and our members’ success.

Rightway is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer that believes in the strength of diverse thought, beliefs, backgrounds, and education. We foster an inclusive culture where differences are celebrated to drive the best business decisions possible. We do not discriminate on any basis protected by applicable law. All employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, need, and performance.

About the job

Mercor connects elite creative and technical talent with leading AI research labs. Headquartered in San Francisco, our investors include Benchmark, General Catalyst, Peter Thiel, Adam D'Angelo, Larry Summers, and Jack Dorsey.

Position: PDF Annotation & Transcription Experts – Japanese
Type:Contract
Compensation:$34/hour
Location:Remote

Role Responsibilities

  • Source documents by finding publicly accessible Japanese PDFs with multimodal elements and record their origins.
  • Annotate structure by identifying and bounding every meaningful region, assigning component types and reading-order indices.
  • Record relationships by linking regions to their parent components like figures or tables.
  • Transcribe faithfully, reproducing all text exactly as it appears, including kanji, hiragana, katakana, and handwritten content.
  • Capture page metadata such as language, document type, source, page dimensions, and flags for tables and handwriting.
  • Review a colleague's work, ensuring tasks are reviewed end-to-end by a second Japanese expert.

Qualifications

Must-Have

  • Native Japanese speaker with full command of kanji, hiragana, and katakana.
  • Professional experience in interpretation, journalism, transcription, translation, or editorial work.
  • Exact character-level accuracy, prioritizing precision over speed.
  • Systematic approach, applying a taxonomy consistently across documents.
  • Comfort with unfamiliar layouts like vertical text and multi-column newspapers.

Preferred

  • Experience with AI training data annotation, labeling, or bilingual evaluation.
  • Skills in transcription and localization, including MTPE, subtitling, and OCR correction.
  • Document production experience such as typesetting, copy-editing, or proofreading.
  • Knowledge of script and encoding, including Unicode normalization and Japanese input methods.

raw.description:
TECHNICAL PRODUCT MANAGER

Product | Full-Time, Salaried | Reports to Head of Product

Company Seeking.com (Reflex Media)

Location Remote, anywhere in the USA

Compensation $145,000 to $190,000 base

Travel Required for team weeks, engineering deep dives, and quarterly planning in Las Vegas

About the Role

Seeking.com is the world's largest premium dating platform, founded and led by an MIT alumnus and headquartered in Las Vegas. We are a technical company. Our product is built on a set of microservices, internal tools, and third-party integrations that our engineering, moderation, support, and finance teams operate every day. Making that machine easy to understand and easy to run is the difference between a product team that ships and one that fights fires.

We are hiring the Technical Product Manager who owns the platform layer underneath the Seeking core experience. Our internal tools, our payments system, our content moderation stack, and the microservices behind them. This is the person who reads the code, walks the flow, sits with the engineers, and turns a tangled system into a clean one.

This role may also be a fit for candidates whose current title is Technical Product Manager, Platform PM, Infrastructure PM, API PM, Payments PM, Product Engineer with a systems bent, or Software Engineer who has moved into product ownership. If your day-to-day is turning technical complexity into simple, well-documented, well-instrumented systems, you should apply regardless of your current title.

This is the role for the Technical PM who is an expert at simplification, at organization, and at making complex systems easier to understand and easier to manage. If your instinct in a review is to add scope, this is not your role. If your instinct is to cut, clarify, and document, keep reading.

What You'll Own

Platform and Internal Systems Ownership

  • Own the roadmap for the internal tools and microservices that support Seeking, including support and moderation tools, automated content moderation systems, the internal payments system, and the technical services that connect them.
  • Treat every internal system as its own product, with a defined user, a metric, and a documented interface.
  • Set quarterly OKRs for your surface and define both leading and lagging KPIs for every Key Result you own.

Simplification, Documentation, and Order

  • Take systems that are messy and make them clean. Rename, restructure, deprecate, and consolidate until a new engineer can be productive on day two.
  • Own the technical documentation for the surfaces you cover in Confluence. Diagrams, data flows, API contracts, runbooks. If it is not documented, it is not shipped.
  • Write specs, user stories, and acceptance criteria clean enough that an engineer using Claude Code can build directly from them.

Doing the Work, Not Just Briefing It

  • Prototype endpoints, admin screens, and internal tools yourself before they hit the engineering backlog. Postman, a Figma flow, a working prototype in code, or a Claude Code or Cursor session that produces a testable artifact.
  • Write SQL against the production data warehouse, read the code, and walk the calls yourself. Do not ask an engineer to answer a question you can answer.
  • Use agent-assisted environments to produce real, testable artifacts inside a single sitting.

Collaboration Across Teams

  • Serve as the primary translator between the engineering team and the non-technical teams (support, moderation, marketing, finance) who depend on these systems.
  • Ensure technical feasibility on every proposal and drive prioritization of what actually gets built.
  • Communicate updates, tradeoffs, and risks to stakeholders in plain, direct language.

Payments and Moderation

  • Own the internal payments system as its own product. Understand the flow end-to-end: authorization, capture, settlement, reconciliation, refunds, chargebacks, tokenization, and PCI scope.
  • Own the moderation and support tooling that keeps the platform safe and the members supported, including our LLM-based message moderation pipeline.
  • Track the metrics that matter: transaction success rate, decline rate by gateway, latency, ticket time-to-resolution, moderation SLA.

Data-Driven Decision-Making

  • Instrument every feature with the data layer in mind from day one, using Amplitude, Mixpanel, Firebase, or comparable.
  • Analyze data to measure the success of every technical change you ship, and follow up with the fix or the deprecation.
  • Propose data-driven improvements to the systems you own, and back them with the numbers.

Required Qualifications

  • Engineering degree. Bachelor's in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field. A business degree on its own does not qualify. If you did not train as an engineer, this is not the role for you.
  • Three to six years in a technical product role, ideally with an engineering background as an individual contributor before moving into product.
  • Working knowledge of system architecture, REST APIs, microservices, and database design. You can read the code, sketch the data flow on a whiteboard, and explain the tradeoffs in an integration.
  • SQL fluency. You can write, read, and debug non-trivial queries against a production warehouse without help.
  • Referenceable shipping history in technical product work. At least one platform, API, or internal system you personally owned end-to-end, with the metric you moved and by how much.
  • Daily, fluent use of agentic AI tools (Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, MCP-based workflows, or comparable). You will be asked to demonstrate this in the interview.
  • Simplification instinct. Show us a system you took over that was messy and left cleaner. Fewer moving parts, better documentation, a metric that improved because of the cleanup.
  • Outstanding written communication. Specs, PRDs, runbooks, decision docs. Your writing should be a competitive advantage, and it should be shorter than the reader expects.
  • Presentation skill. You can walk a room through a complex system in ten minutes without losing anyone. Direct answers, no meandering. If a simple question gets a ten-minute answer, this is not the role for you.
  • Fluency in the operating stack. Confluence for documentation, Jira for shipping, Monday for cross-team scheduling. You can operate the stack without needing a project manager to do it for you.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on background as a software engineer before moving into product, ideally in backend, platform, or infrastructure.
  • Working experience with payments on a technical level: systems, flow, entities, PCI scope, and reconciliation.
  • Working experience with support ticketing and content moderation systems, including LLM-based moderation pipelines.
  • Cloud fluency (AWS preferred), including a working understanding of DevOps practices and deployment pipelines.
  • Prior experience in dating, social, marketplace, subscription, or other consumer-focused product categories.
  • Public work we can look at: a technical portfolio, an open-source contribution, a spec you wrote, a system you diagrammed, or an agent toolkit you have shared.
  • Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.

Compensation & Benefits

Base salary: $145,000 to $190,000, commensurate with experience.

Full-time, salaried, fully remote within the US.

99% coverage of our medical base plan, dental, and vision insurance. 65% coverage for qualified dependents. 100% coverage of short-term disability, long-term disability, and life insurance for qualified employees. 50% 401(k) match up to 6% per month. Flexible Spending Account. Flexible paid time off.

Direct exposure to the CEO from day one, and a clear growth path as platform scope expands.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Reflex Media is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We strictly prohibit discrimination of any kind. Candidates are encouraged to apply for qualified positions regardless of race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, or any other protected characteristics as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. Reflex Media's hiring decisions are based solely on qualifications, merit, and the needs of the company. All offers of employment are contingent upon the completion of a full background and reference check.

Why Merit?

At Merit Medical, our mission is to create innovative medical devices that improve lives. Our goal is to hire and develop people who want to build something special through hard work, team effort, and commitment. Together, we are making a difference in the lives of patients around the world.

SUMMARY OF DUTIES

This position is responsible for the development and implementation of the strategies and tactics needed to continue to expand the use of the Embolotherapy portfolio of products by healthcare providers. This includes product lifecycle management, new product introductions, market research, advertising, congresses, professional education, and field sales support.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Define and lead the Embolotherapy business unit strategy developing the annual marketing plan in collaboration with all other relevant stakeholders.

  • Ensure execution of the business unit strategy, applying appropriate processes, regular program reviews, definition and follow-up of appropriate dashboards/metrics

  • Maintain product knowledge and sales information within all product lines

  • Provide the leadership team regularly with sales metrics and analysis for the business unit:

  • YTD, QTD, MTD product sales and margin by region

  • Relevant trends vs prior year budget

  • Market share changes and corrective actions where required

  • Lead the go-to-market strategy of new products/solutions managing the cross-functional team and execute pre-launch, launch and post-launch initiatives, ensure results and proper execution in targeted geographies.

  • Manage and continue to grow Merit Medical’s share of mind and exceptional brand recognition as a result of the leading products and services.

  • Understand associated diseases today and tomorrow, emerging therapies and technologies, competitive activities, etc. through participation to scientific congresses, market/business intelligence, networking in the field, advisory boards, in particular building a network with physician community and Key Opinion Leader (KOL)

  • Understand HCP needs through market research and advisory boards. Lead tactics and events to engage and educate these key customer groups. Develop HCPs engagement strategies at professional society meetings and congresses.

  • Direct the timely delivery of marketing promotional and resource materials to internal stakeholders.

  • Oversees marketing efforts with the global team associated with new product development.

  • In collaboration with Med Affairs, lead in region a robust clinical communication plan to support advanced and therapeutic products in market

  • Ensure that life-cycle management strategies and demand forecasts are in place for full portfolio in collaboration with supply chain

  • Develop and maintainappropriate resourcing and budget management

  • Assist the Marketing Sr Director and VP to elevate marketing capabilities in the team

  • Performs other related duties and tasks, as required.

SUMMARY OF MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

  • Educational experience equivalent to a Bachelor's Degree in Marketing or related field.

  • Work related experience equivalent to ten years, with at least five of those in marketing or product management in multi country setting.

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to manage projects efficiently and effectively and to meet deadlines in a timely manner.

  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills.

  • Demonstrated computer skills preferably ppt, spreadsheets and other applicable software programs

  • Excellent presentation skills and the ability to prepare professional written and oral presentations and market analysis.

  • Strong market research skills and the ability to report research findings with high degree of validity and reliability.

We are Global

Founded in 1987, Merit Medical Systems, Inc. is a leading manufacturer and marketer of proprietary disposable medical devices used in interventional, diagnostic and therapeutic procedures, particularly in cardiology, radiology, oncology, critical care and endoscopy. Merit serves client hospitals worldwide with an international sales force and clinical support team totalling in excess of 500 individuals. Merit employs approximately 6,300 people worldwide.

Merit Medical EMEA currently has over 300 employees, spread over more than 20 countries in the EMEA region.

Merit Maastricht (The Netherlands) is the European Headquarters and Distribution Center of Excellence. Much of Merit Medical’s world-class customer service happens here along with our excellent physician training courses. More than 100 employees work at this growing Merit campus and enjoy many benefits, such as flexible working hours and competitive salaries as well as learning opportunities and internships.

Culture

A supportive and collaborative environment make Merit Medical a friendly, enjoyable place to work. We are proud of our energetic and dynamic culture. Diversity & Inclusion is evident here with a 50/50 ratio of male and female employees and more than 30 nationalities. We value every employee as an individual.

We are looking for an experienced Data Engineer / Data Analyst to complete and integrate an existing AI Sales Development Representative (AI SDR) Bot.

Approximately 90% of the application is already developed. The primary requirement is to connect the existing components and communication channels and make the solution operational.

Position Summary

The Senior Manager, PMO is responsible for leading the Project Management Office supporting the hearing aid retail business, with accountability for planning, governance, execution, and delivery of growth driver initiatives and cross-functional projects across North America. This role leads a team of project management professionals who partner with business leaders, Retail Operations, Managed Care, Marketing, Contact Center, Finance, IT, and other stakeholders to ensure initiatives are clearly prioritized, effectively resourced, and delivered on time with measurable business outcomes. The Senior Manager, PMO serves as a strategic business partner and execution leader, ensuring technology-enabled and system-related projects remain business-led, operationally practical, and aligned to field and customer needs rather than driven solely by technical priorities.

Responsibilities & Duties

  • Lead the PMO function supporting hearing aid retail growth, operational execution, and enterprise transformation initiatives.
  • Build, lead, and develop a high-performing team of project managers responsible for managing strategic growth driver initiatives and cross-functional projects.
  • Establish and continuously improve PMO standards, project governance, delivery frameworks, tools, templates, and operating rhythms that drive consistency, transparency, and accountability.
  • Lead portfolio governance processes, including project intake, prioritization, sequencing, approval frameworks, portfolio reviews, and executive-level reporting.
  • Partner with business leaders to translate strategic priorities into actionable project plans, milestones, resource needs, risk plans, and measurable success metrics.
  • Oversee delivery of high-impact initiatives across Retail Operations, Managed Care, Marketing, Contact Center, Finance, Training, HR, IT, and other functions.
  • Ensure business ownership of technology-enabled and system-related projects by aligning requirements, process design, change readiness, testing, training, adoption, and operational outcomes to business needs.
  • Serve as a key liaison between business teams and IT, ensuring IT partners are engaged appropriately while project direction, prioritization, and requirements remain grounded in business strategy and field execution needs.
  • Monitor project performance, risks, dependencies, budgets, timelines, decisions, and issue resolution to ensure predictable delivery and timely escalation when needed.
  • Develop executive dashboards, status reporting, KPIs, and portfolio analytics that enable data-driven decision-making and organizational transparency.
  • Lead resource planning and capacity discussions to support realistic prioritization, effective sequencing, and sustainable execution across business and technical teams.
  • Support change management planning, stakeholder communication, training coordination, and adoption tracking to ensure initiatives are implemented successfully in the field.
  • Drive continuous improvement in project delivery capabilities, PMO maturity, governance discipline, and cross-functional execution effectiveness.
  • Coach project managers and business stakeholders on project management best practices, business case development, risk management, and execution discipline.
  • All other duties as assigned.

Job Qualifications

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Operations, Healthcare Administration, Management, Information Systems, Project Management, or a related field.

Work Experience:

  • 8+ years of progressive experience in project management, program management, business transformation, retail operations, or related disciplines.
  • 3+ years of experience leading project managers, project teams, or cross-functional workstreams.
  • Experience managing complex, cross-functional initiatives in matrixed organizations with both business and technical stakeholders.
  • Experience partnering with IT on system implementations, business requirements, user acceptance testing, change readiness, training, and adoption planning.
  • Experience supporting or improving project governance, project intake, prioritization, status reporting, risk management, and delivery standards.
  • Healthcare, hearing care, retail healthcare, managed care, multi-site operations, or field operations experience preferred.

Key Skills Required:

  • Strong project and program management expertise with the ability to drive execution across multiple priorities.
  • Business-first mindset with the ability to challenge, clarify, and translate operational needs into practical project plans and system requirements.
  • Ability to partner effectively with IT while ensuring system-related initiatives remain grounded in business objectives, field workflows, and operational outcomes.
  • Excellent stakeholder management, influencing, facilitation, and relationship-building skills across business and technical teams.
  • Strong communication skills, including the ability to prepare clear status updates, decision materials, dashboards, and risk summaries for senior leaders.
  • Ability to lead through ambiguity, manage competing priorities, identify dependencies, and escalate decisions appropriately.
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to connect project execution to revenue growth, operational performance, clinic productivity, customer experience, and field adoption.
  • Experience with PMO or project management tools such as Smartsheet, Jira, Planview, OnePlan, Microsoft Project, Power BI, or similar platforms preferred.
  • PMP, Prosci, Lean Six Sigma, or related project, program, or change management certification preferred.
  • Continuous improvement mindset with a focus on accountability, practical execution, measurable outcomes, and scalable ways of working.

Clinical Trial Supplies Manager (Remote Based)

Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.

Our Clinical Solutions team members act with a drug development mindset, applying their years of experience and deep expertise to truly understand customer needs and represent those in the solutions we shape.

Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to deliver – for one another, our customers, and, most importantly, for those in need.

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:

Why Syneos Health

• We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
• We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
• We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

Job Responsibilities

Clinical Trial Supply Management

  • Lead end-to-end clinical trial supply planning and logistics for assigned studies.
  • Develop and maintain supply forecasts, inventory plans, distribution strategies, and resupply plans.
  • Ensure compliance with GMP, GCP, SOPs, and regulatory requirements.
  • Monitor inventory levels, product expiry dates, and supply risks to ensure uninterrupted study execution.
  • Oversee packaging, labeling, distribution activities, and Interactive Response Technology (IRT) supply strategies.

Project Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Represent Clinical Supply Chain on Clinical Study Teams.
  • Partner closely with Clinical Operations, Project Management, Technical Operations, Procurement, and Supply Chain teams.
  • Lead cross-functional supply meetings and drive timely decision-making.
  • Align supply plans with study timelines, enrollment forecasts, and operational requirements.

Vendor & Budget Management

  • Identify, select, and manage clinical supply vendors and service providers.
  • Oversee vendor performance, contract deliverables, and financial commitments.
  • Manage co-medication sourcing and associated budgets and spending.

Risk Management & Reporting

  • Develop contingency plans and mitigation strategies to address supply risks.
  • Track and report inventory, supply status, forecasts, and project metrics.
  • Maintain study documentation and Trial Master Files to ensure inspection readiness.

Leadership & Process Improvement

  • Provide oversight and direction to Clinical Trial Supplies Associates (CTSAs).
  • Participate in SOP development and departmental process improvement initiatives.
  • Support internal training and contribute to operational excellence projects.

Business Development

  • Participate in bid defenses and client presentations.
  • Build strong customer relationships and contribute to new business opportunities.

Qualification

  • Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent) in Life Sciences, Medicine, Pharmacy, Nursing, or a related field.
  • Prior experience within a Contract Research Organization (CRO), pharmaceutical, or biotechnology company, with responsibilities in project management and/or clinical trial supplies management.
  • Strong knowledge of Good Clinical Practice (GCP), International Council for Harmonisation (ICH) guidelines, Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP), and applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Excellent organizational and project management skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage time effectively and work independently.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to inform, influence, and persuade stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines while maintaining a high standard of quality in a fast-paced environment.
  • High proficiency in the English language.
  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office applications.
  • Willingness and ability to travel as required, up to 25%.

Experience Requirements

  • Five to seven (5-7) years of relevant clinical trial experience.
  • Minimum of two (2) years of experience as a Clinical Trial Supplies Manager (CTSM) or in a comparable clinical supply chain leadership role.

At  Syneos Health, we believe in providing an environment and culture in which Our People can thrive, develop and advance. We reward and recognize our people by providing valuable benefits and a quality-of-life balance. The benefits for this position may include a company car or car allowance, Health benefits to include Medical, Dental and Vision, Company match 401k, eligibility to participate in Employee Stock Purchase Plan, Eligibility to earn commissions/bonus based on company and individual performance, and flexible paid time off (PTO) and sick time. Because certain states and municipalities have regulated paid sick time requirements, eligibility for paid sick time may vary depending on where you work. Syneos complies with all applicable federal, state, and municipal paid sick time requirements.

$79,800.00 - $139,600.00

The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high of the Syneos Health range for this position. Actual salary will vary based on various factors such as the candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role.

Get to know Syneos Health

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

Level II is a senior IC role with a clear path forward. From there, the natural exits are Technical Account Manager (dedicated technical partnership with named enterprise accounts) or Solutions Architect (pre- and post-sales technical advisory and custom work).

  • Comfortable with scripting — PowerShell, Bash, or Python for diagnostics and automation

raw.description:
From empowering entrepreneurs to build successful businesses, to supporting their clients to arrange 'me time' moments, we're in the business of elevating people - helping them to thrive and feel fantastic. Lifting others up can be hard, heavy work, and we passionately believe that the sense of purpose and personal satisfaction this brings are worth it.

What started in Poland is now an international, cloud-based marketplace that's scaling rapidly. We bring independent business owners together with their customers on a product that connects creative communities and opens up worlds of opportunities.

For our providers, our products offer services for getting booked, paid, and building a loyal client base. For their clients, we're where they can find their favourite spots, discover new businesses and book appointments in an instant.

Working in a rapidly growing, ever-changing scale-up comes with its own set of opportunities and challenges. If you prefer a stable environment, with clear processes and structures then, we've got to be honest, you won't always find that here. However, if you enjoy inventively solving problems with others, helping create clarity when things get confusing, and prioritising your own path within ambiguity, then the chances are that you'll love the opportunities available to grow your career at Booksy.

The people you'll like to work with and things you'll enjoy impacting:

As an AI Native Software Engineer reporting to the People Technology Manager in our People & Culture team, your purpose will be to work out what AI could do here that nobody has thought to ask for yet - and then build it.

This is a brand new role, so a lot of it is yours to define. Specifically, you will:

  • Experiment first. We have used AI for the things we already knew AI could do. Your job starts where that stops.
  • Build what you propose. Ideas are the starting point, not the deliverable. You will take concepts through to working proofs of concept.
  • Ship AI-first features from ideation to launch, working agent-first rather than retrofitting AI onto existing tools.
  • Work across Product & Tech. You will have a mentor in our engineering organisation and your career will be levelled there - not siloed inside People & Culture.
  • Partner with experienced engineers, product managers and designers to get things live.

Requirements

Essentially, to ensure you succeed in this role you're going to need…

  • Commercial experience in software engineering or another technical role - however you arrived there, and whatever you did before that.
  • Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, Gemini and Cursor, plus a working understanding of agentic workflows and concepts like MCP.
  • Confidence in at least one modern programming language - Python or JavaScript.
  • A portfolio, open-source contribution or project you can walk us through. We care more about what you have built than where you built it.
  • Fluency in English. Why? English is our company language and is used for any business-wide communications, so we need you to be able to speak English to feel like an integrated part of Booksy.

It will also help you to have…

  • Open-source contributions with a visible history we can look at.
  • Something you have built with agentic frameworks or MCP that went beyond following a tutorial.
  • Exposure to Google Cloud.

Benefits

  • We're proudly distributed across the globe, with each market being remote-first.
  • Depending on which market you're joining, you might have office access or be fully remote - either works. All we ask is that you're based in Poland, Spain or the UK for this role.
  • Additional benefits that might differ depending on the location. You shall be provided with the benefits details during or after your first conversation with one of our TA Specialists.


How AI helps us find great people

Think of our AI tool as a really smart assistant for our recruitment team. Its job? To help us move faster, stay consistent, and make sure no great candidates are overlooked. Every application goes through the same AI review to help us spot skills that match the role - but don't worry, AI never makes the decisions. Real people do. Our recruiters and hiring managers handle every final call. And we regularly review how the tool is used to keep things fair, ethical, and compliant with data protection laws. Curious about how it works? You can always ask how AI was used in your application - it won't affect your chances in any way.

Our Diversity and Inclusion Commitment:

We work in a highly creative and diverse industry so it goes without saying that we strive to create an inclusive environment for all. We welcome people from all backgrounds and are committed to fair consideration in our hiring process. If you have any accessibility needs or require reasonable adjustments during the interview process, please contact us at , so we can best support you.

Kindly submit your application and CV in English to ensure it is successfully reviewed.

Overview (Why This Role?)

Hearst Health is seeking a part-time Graduate Research Associate, Clinical Outcomes to help quantify and communicate the clinical impact of our software, data, and decision-support solutions.
This role is designed for a student pursuing an advanced degree in public health, health services research, epidemiology, biostatistics, health informatics, or a related field who wants to apply rigorous research methods to real-world healthcare questions.
The core question behind the role is straightforward but important: Do patients and healthcare organizations achieve better clinical outcomes when they use Hearst Health solutions?
Working with Hearst Health leadership and the Chief Medical Officers and clinical leaders across our businesses, the Graduate Research Associate will help turn that question into testable hypotheses, design appropriate analyses, evaluate real-world data, and develop credible evidence about the relationship between use of our solutions and clinical outcomes.
This is not primarily an academic research role. The objective is to produce rigorous, defensible evidence that can inform product strategy and, where supported by the findings, strengthen how Hearst Health communicates the value of its solutions to customers and the market.
The position is expected to require approximately 10–20 hours per week, with flexibility to accommodate an academic schedule.
Compensation: $50 an hour

This position is eligible for Remote Work.

About Hearst Health

The mission of Hearst Health is to guide healthcare organizations by delivering essential intelligence and software that improve the quality, safety and efficiency of care. Hearst Health has been innovating with care for more than 40 years, with a commitment to making a lasting positive impact on health. The Hearst Health companies — FDB, Homecare Homebase, MCG, MHK, QGenda and Zynx Health — elevate care by informing and empowering participants across the health journey. To learn more, follow @Hearst-Health on LinkedIn.

Two Chairs is building a new kind of mental health system based on the idea that the status quo isn’t good enough. Industry-best clinician experiences, better client outcomes, groundbreaking innovation, and access to the highest quality care are how we’ll raise the bar for the entire industry. With that, we're excited and honored to have been recognized as a 2025 Great Place to Work and 2025 Fortune's Best Workplaces in Healthcare.

One of our company values is "Embrace Differences" and diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging are the principles guiding how we build our business and teams. We encourage interested candidates from all backgrounds to apply even if they don't think they meet some expectations of the role.

Why Two Chairs is consistently a Great Place to Work

  • Competitive Pay: Earn a total hourly rate of $62–$96 (guaranteed base + incentive potential), paid semi-monthly. Base rate determined by clinical experience, place of residence, and overall qualifications.
  • Truly Flexible Work: Work remotely with a schedule that fits your life: no nights, no weekends, no on-call responsibilities. We also provide paid administrative time so documentation doesn’t follow you home.
  • Mission-Driven, Clinician-Led: We’re dedicated to creating a world where everyone has access to exceptional mental healthcare. Clinical decisions are made by clinicians for clinicians, ensuring you’re supported by a team that is focused on centering the client and enabling clinicians to deliver exceptional care.
  • Clinical Excellence Comes First: You’ll join a deeply collaborative environment, with access to physician partners, therapists, and crisis support services. Our integrated platform provides tools that enable measurement-based care, clinical decision support, and seamless information sharing.

What You’ll Do

  • Conduct 60-minute psychiatry assessments and 30 minute follow-up sessions remotely.
  • Prescribe and manage psychiatric medications, including controlled substances, in accordance with state and federal regulations.
  • Integrate brief psychotherapy when clinically appropriate to support your clients in reaching their goals efficiently and sustainably.
  • Collaborate with physicians and clinical leadership for support, escalation, and continued learning.
  • Partner with therapists and other providers through integrated care plans, shared treatment insights, and team consultation spaces.
  • Use data-informed tools and measurement-based care to tailor treatment plans and improve outcomes.
  • Contribute to a growing, diverse community of clinicians committed to redefining mental health care.

What success looks like

In your first 90 days

You will become comfortable with Two Chairs systems, processes, and teams, supported by an onboarding team and clinical leadership. You will gradually build a caseload and deliver exceptional mental health care. You will collaborate with team members and help refine workflows and care protocols.

By the end of your first year

You will have established a robust caseload of clients and delivered exceptional care, as evidenced by clinical outcomes. You will have made contributions to our program and to a world where everyone has access to exceptional mental health care.

What We Offer

  • Compensation you can count on:
    • Competitive Pay: Hourly rate of $62-$96 based on clinical experience, place of residence, and overall qualifications
    • Guaranteed Onboarding Support: Earn 100% of your hourly rate during your initial 6-month ramp period while you build your caseload
    • Sustainable Base + Incentive: Following the ramp period, you’ll receive a guaranteed base (80% of your hourly rate) plus an incentive structure that rewards clinical productivity and the integration of psychotherapy
    • Comprehensive Coverage: we pay for administrative time, clinical consultations, trainings, and no-shows.
    • Long-term Growth: Eligibility for annual performance-based merit increases
  • Comprehensive Benefits:
    • Sick leave
    • Access to 401(k) retirement plan options
    • Credentialing and cross-licensing support
    • License renewal fee reimbursement
    • Free Continuing Medical Education (CME) access
    • Technology package including laptop, EHR system, HIPAA compliant video platform, and more
    • Malpractice Insurance provided
  • Flexible Schedule:
    • Part-time, W2 position (8-16 hours per week) with opportunity for increased hours over time.
    • Expect to spend ~75% of time on direct client care and ~25% focused on admin/ supervisory work. The balance may vary based on team needs.
    • Build a schedule that works for you within our operating hours of M-F, 8am-8pm.
    • Start date: September 2026
  • Clinical Coverage:
    • Backup coverage, so your clients are supported when you’re away
    • Dedicated 24/7 crisis line available for immediate risk assessments and arrangement of in-person interventions if needed

Compensation Ranges

  • Zone 1 / New York City and San Francisco | $80-108/hour
    • New hires can reasonably expect an offer between $80 and $96/hour
  • Zone 2 / Portland, Boston, Chicago, Washington DC, New Jersey, Washington,
    all other CA locations | $70-95/hour
    • New hires can reasonably expect an offer between $70 and $86/hour
  • Zone 3 / Miami, Philadelphia, Denver, Austin, Dallas, Houston | $67-91/hour
    • New hires can reasonably expect an offer between $67 and $81/hour
  • Zone 4 / All other locations | $62-87/hour
    • New hires can reasonably expect an offer between $62 and $76/hour

Who You Are

  • A board-certified Psychiatric Mental Health Nurse Practitioner (PMHNP-BC)
  • Licensed to practice in Washington as a PMHNP (additional licensure a plus!)
  • Open to obtaining additional state licenses to support company expansion. Two Chairs covers all costs and provides full administrative support for the cross-licensing process.
  • 2+ years of experience providing mental health services as a PMHNP
  • Active DEA license in Washington
  • Experienced in delivering remote telepsychiatry services
  • Passionate about high-quality, measurement-based, collaborative care
  • Eager to join a community of clinicians who are driven by purpose and help us build upon our psychiatry program to improve our services and systems continually
  • Able to start in September 2026

The Security Analyst is responsible for assisting with the day-to-day operations of security program. The Security Analyst is tasked with providing technical expertise in all areas of information security. They will work closely with the security team and other various teams across the business to ensure that systems and networks are designed, developed, deployed, and managed securely. The Security Analyst leads the departmental KPI activities, roadmap tracking as well as monitoring and administering the annual third-party security assessments and client related compliance requests. This role is responsible for managing quarterly security program activities, including access reviews and Internal audit activities. The Security Analyst will research and report on best of breed security products and remain current with emerging cyber technologies and threats that help educate and maintain a secure environment according to Confidentiality, Integrity, Availability control requirements.

Since 1989, SHI International Corp. has helped organizations change the world through technology. We’ve grown every year since, and today we’re proud to be a $16 billion global provider of IT solutions and services.

Over 17,000 organizations worldwide rely on SHI’s concierge approach to help them solve what’s next. But the heartbeat of SHI is our employees – all 7,000 of them. If you join our team, you’ll enjoy:

  • Our commitment to diversity, as the largest minority- and woman-owned enterprise in the U.S.

  • Continuous professional growth and leadership opportunities.

  • Health, wellness, and financial benefits to offer peace of mind to you and your family.

  • World-class facilities and the technology you need to thrive – in our offices or yours.

Job Summary

We are looking for a passionate and experienced Field Account Manager to be responsible for engaging with key customers in this Public Sector Field sales overlay position by building and preserving trusted relationships. The Field Account Manager will be the primary point of contact between the customer(s) contract stakeholders and SHI.  This person will collaborate with the Account Executive team to optimize the opportunity presented by our contract vehicles with the customer(s). 

The Field Account Manager will focus on efficiently managing transactional business, extending our partner network, being the subject matter expert on terms and conditions of the contract(s), and coordinate with partners and internal teams to deliver on client expectations.  The Field Account Manager will also serve as a point of contact for Accounts that need temporary coverage due to an Account Executive transition or absence. In addition, the right candidate will have a thorough knowledge of SHI’s business and offerings, participate in implementing strategic plans to grow the account, and help to identify potential new opportunities.
